thread.label: Isaiah 59:1-4
thread.text: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

classes.title: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:28
precepts.why:
“For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity.” Our hands in the black and brown community are defiled with blood. In Joliet a young man, twenty-three years old, shot to death his own mother, his aunt, his uncle, his bedridden brother and his three sisters, killed another man and shot one more, and then shot himself. That's trauma right there, and the law explains it: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart.”

The Lord shall smite thee with madness: meaning our people are insane. No rhyme, no reason to what they do or why they do it. That's being smitten with madness. We have generational curses. Three teens on a thirty-hour spree of armed robberies and the murder of a churchgoing man; a woman charged with stabbing and killing a three-year-old boy, appearing in court laughing and smiling: that is stricken with madness.

The Bible says, thou shalt not kill, and we are not taught that in church, so some of us grow up with a hateful and murderous spirit on us. No matter how bad, insulting or degrading these videos are, they are filtered through the Bible, showing the stage and state of where we are today, and it is still proof that we are the children of Israel under the curses. The Bible ain't the white man's book. The Bible is our book.

That is why the Lord's hand is not shortened and his ear is not heavy, and still he does not save: “your iniquities have separated between you and your God.”

precepts.label: Revelation 13:9-10
precepts.why:
“None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth.” You might say, that's not right; our people are in the street all the time crying, no justice, no peace. But the justice our people want is called money. They don't want the justice of the Bible. Here is God's justice: “If any man have an ear, let him hear. He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

Now that's justice. And you know what our people say? No, you hate the white man. They know what the scripture means: the one who led into slavery going into slavery, the one who killed with the sword being put to death by the sword. And they say, no, we don't want that kind of justice. We want money, money, money.

That is Isaiah 59:4: none calling for God's justice. They cry for justice in the streets, but when the justice of God is read to them, they call it hateful.

precepts.label: Psalms 89:14
precepts.why:
“Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.” God's throne is all about justice and judgment. That's exactly what the world doesn't want.

“nor any pleadeth for truth”: they are not pleading for God's truth. The families of our brothers and sisters put to death unjustly, Sandra Bland and the rest, want the truth regarding their case, but they don't want God's truth as a whole. We may march with them and support them, but there is no internal change: they are mad at the white man and still celebrating Christmas and the white man's holidays. “be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” If I used to celebrate Easter, now I celebrate Passover. They are making a conscious effort not to change.

The Lord is coming with justice and judgment, the habitation of his throne. That is why the world, which cries for justice, will be angry when it comes.

precepts.label: Revelation 11:18
precepts.why:
Everybody says, I can't wait until Jesus comes back. Let's see what the Bible says: “And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come.” All these nations, countries and religious organizations say they want the Messiah to return, and the Bible prophesies they will be angry.

Why are they angry? Because “Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne.” The Lord is coming with justice and judgment, and the nations don't want that. Many of those nations are living on stolen land, like America. This is stolen land. They are lying when they say they can't wait. Christ's wrath is coming; he's not coming to hand out lollipops and hugs and kisses.

“and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great.” You know what that reward is? Power. He's going to give his servants power.

“and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.” That's them. They say the aerosols in the black and brown community are destroying the ozone layer, not their rockets and missiles. All that climate change global BS: they are the ones destroying the earth, digging up and sucking out the oil that is meant to lubricate the tectonic plates, and then they wonder why the earthquakes are happening. They know it, and that's why they will be angry at his return. None calleth for the justice of God.

thread.label: Isaiah 59:1-21
thread.text: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 5:15-23
precepts.why:
Isaiah 59 ends with the Lord seeing “that there was no man”, no intercessor, so his own arm brought salvation: Christ “put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing.” “The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob”: not all nations. And his covenant is his spirit upon us and his words in our mouth, and in our children's mouths, and our children's children's, for ever. Wisdom of Solomon shows what that Redeemer brings.

“But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord, and the care of them is with the most High.” There is no death to the righteous. If you are in this truth keeping the commandments in the faith of Christ, you live forever; our brothers and sisters whose bodies returned to the dust, those spirits are coming back. We have to believe that.

“Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the Lord’s hand.” The glorious kingdom shall be on earth: that is New Jerusalem. The crown is the one in 2 Esdras 2:42-45: we are going to get crowned with power. “For with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.”

“He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour”: Christ is coming back for war. “And make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies”: that leviathan is going to come out and attack those bastards on the navy. “He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate”, the same as we read in Isaiah 59, “and true judgment instead of an helmet. He shall take holiness for an invincible shield. His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.”

“Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.” Those weapons won't miss; that lightning won't miss. “And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow”, like in the time of Joshua, “and the water of the sea shall rage against them”, tsunamis, “and the floods shall cruelly drown them. Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty.”

That is what we are waiting for: the second coming of Christ. And God would not be just to let the nations off the hook; if he punished his own people, America, England, Japan and Australia will not be unpunished. So while we wait, we must be preparing our hearts, our minds and our souls.

thread.label: Isaiah 59:5-8
thread.text: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

classes.title: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.label: Matthew 3:7-8
precepts.why:
Isaiah 59:5 says “They hatch cockatrice’ eggs”, and a cockatrice is like a poisonous snake. Put together everything from verses two to four, the iniquities that separated us from our God, the hands defiled with blood, the lips that have spoken lies, and this is what comes of it: “he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.” The eggs that are crushed are the kids that come out: a little baby snake. They produce evil followers.

Many years ago at a community meeting a black woman screamed at the police that they were selling drugs in her building and nobody was doing anything. The police set up a sting and locked up two dudes putting drugs in the mailboxes: her own sons. Then she came back saying it was false, with them on video. These are the eggs, the snake eggs coming out.

John the Baptist saw the same thing: “But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers”. That is the same thing Isaiah was talking about. “who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come? Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance”.

A generation of vipers cannot just say it repents. You have to bring forth God's commandments in application; that is what proves your repentance.

precepts.label: Matthew 12:34
precepts.why:
Now Christ is speaking to them: “O generation of vipers”. That goes back to Isaiah 59, the cockatrice' eggs that break out into a viper. Christ called them vipers, and John the Baptist called them vipers. And their children are little snakes too.

“how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.” What is in the heart comes out of the mouth. A generation of vipers cannot speak good things, because what fills their heart is evil.

That is Isaiah 59 again. Before verse 5, verse 3 said our lips have spoken lies and our tongue perverseness. The lips speak lies and the tongue perverseness because the heart is full of iniquity, and the eggs they hatch are the same kind as the ones who laid them.

precepts.label: Isaiah 65:2
precepts.why:
“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. See what our people do: they walk after their own thoughts. They don't give a damn what the Bible says; I do what I want to do.

And their thoughts are the white man's thoughts. Our people follow all these man-made religions, and they don't teach God's laws, his commandments, his statutes. We ain't got to keep no laws, because that is what all these white people were teaching: don't keep no laws.

So what do you get? Those vipers hatch eggs, and what comes out? Little vipers, little snakes. Your son, little Tyrone, is a snake, and your daughter, little Chenique, was a snake too. That is what God is saying in Isaiah 59:5, and it is why verse 7 says “their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity”: a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts.

precepts.label: Job 8:13-15
precepts.why:
Isaiah 59 says they “weave the spider’s web” and “Their webs shall not become garments”. Job explains the spider's web. “So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish: Whose hope shall be cut off”, because they are hypocrites, “and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.”

Their trust shall be as a spider's web: you get tangled up in that thing, and that spider comes out and bites you and eats you up.

“He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.” Your house won't stand. A people who forget God weave their webs and lean on what they built, but it cannot cover them or hold them up. That is why Isaiah 59:6 goes on, “neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.”

precepts.label: Isaiah 30:1-2
precepts.why:
Isaiah 59:6 says “neither shall they cover themselves with their works”, and Isaiah 30 shows the covering they use instead. “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me”: they are looking for counsel, but not from God. “and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”, not according to the Bible, “that they may add sin to sin”.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth”. At that time it was actual Egypt, but today it's America, spiritual Egypt. They have not asked the prophets what the Bible says. They go “to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” America ain't the real Egypt, but it is the shadow of Egypt, and our people trust in it.

That is why the act of violence is in their hands. A cruise line banned passengers for life over a brawl in the buffet; graduation ceremonies break out into fights with families arrested, a day of celebration turned into chaos. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves, following the Democratic or the Republican party, the cross and the white Jesus, and whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.

thread.label: Isaiah 59:9-15
thread.text: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

classes.title: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:29
precepts.why:
“We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.” We got eyes, but we act like we ain't got none. We act like what we just saw didn't happen. The curse said it would be so: “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.”

We are like blind people, but we have eyes. We see we're not prospering as a people. We see we're under constant oppression as a people. But we act like we don't see it, because oppression has become so normal to us; it's our everyday life.

It's high noon, but in our minds we are so spiritually blind it is like night for us. “we are in desolate places as dead men”: that's the black and brown community, desolate places, our people like the walking dead. Isaiah 59 is Deuteronomy 28:29 in real time.

That is why verse 9 says, “Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us.” We want to live filthy lives, evil lives, violent lives, and then expect justice from God. It don't work like that. Oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 11:12-13
precepts.why:
There is a difference between being spiritually slow and being spiritually dead. “we are in desolate places as dead men,” but Sirach shows what the nation needs: “Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty.” We usually read it as an individual, but think about it on a bigger scale. You might say this is Joe or Bob. No, this is us.

Slow, needing help, lacking ability, full of poverty: that is our people. “yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,” and lifted up his head from misery, so that many that saw it marvelled at him.

The nations are going to marvel when God raises us up. It will be such a shock that this low, degenerate race of people is now going to rule the earth. We lack the ability now; it is the Lord's eye that sets us up from our low estate.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 2:20-21
precepts.why:
“But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” The great house is the nation of Israel; think of it as whatever IUIC school you come from. Every camp leader, the head of the sanctuary, must be able to identify the gold brothers and the silver brothers, the gold sisters and silver sisters, and also look through the school and say, this brother and this sister is earth, this one is wood.

If you can't discern that, you'll have problems in the school, putting people in positions that don't fit them. Marcus Garvey had his ships and put his best friends over them, and they didn't know how to run a ship: one crashed, one went to his girlfriend's house, and he lost it all because of friendship. Shake the friendship appointments. Who is best qualified? Who knows what they're doing? A dummy who doesn't study set up as a school leader, and all hell breaks loose. If sanctuary leaders have no discernment, they are spiritually blind and destined for ruin.

Some brothers and sisters are just slow and need more time to grow. Fine; don't put them in that position yet if others are better qualified. “If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.” Purge yourself from the wood and earth spirits. They see this truth not as a government, not as the mustard seed of a government, but as a social club, dancing every new moon and confused when it comes to God's work. That is how a people groping like the blind becomes vessels unto honour.

precepts.label: John 3:18-21
precepts.why:
The voices of our people conceive and utter from the heart words of falsehood, lies on top of lies. Christ answers: “He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.” If you believe on the black Messiah, you are not condemned; if you believe not, you're not even keeping commandment one.

“And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Christ is that light that came into the world, and men love darkness, sin, rather than light, Christ and keeping the commandments. It didn't change from Isaiah to John; it's the same thing: “we wait for light, but behold obscurity.”

“For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.” They hate Christ, they hate keeping the laws, they hate the commandments, because if you come to Christ your deeds will be reproved: have no other gods before me, bow down to no graven image, remember the Sabbath, honour your father and your mama, thou shalt not kill. They don't want to hear that.

“But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.” We want Christ, the word of God, to make our deeds manifest. What am I? Lord, show me.

precepts.label: Amos 5:10
precepts.why:
“Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” If you depart from evil by repenting, you make yourself a prey to everybody around you; everybody around you hates your guts now. Amos says the same thing: “They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.”

That includes some of your own mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers. They hate the one who rebukes and abhor the one who speaks uprightly, because “truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.”

“and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.” There was no true judgment in the earth. The one who departs from evil is hated for it, and the Lord sees it.

thread.text: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return a

precepts.label: Jeremiah 2:27-28
precepts.why:
Israel is found “Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth”. The stock is a piece of wood, a wooden god. The stone is the Kaaba stone, the black stone in Mecca that people come from all around the world to kiss, revered as a relic from heaven. To say to that stone, you brought me forth, is to say, you created me.

The Lord says why: “for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.” Then the Lord answers: “But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble”. Where is the Kaaba stone that you made? Where is the wooden god that you made? Let them rise up and save you.

Then: “for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.” We started to worship many gods, and Allah was one of them, around 639 AD. That is the harlotry of Jeremiah 3:1-3: Israel “played the harlot with many lovers”, sat for them “as the Arabian in the wilderness” when the Arabs came conquering and forcing Islam on our people all through North Africa, and then we forced it on our own people too.

So the “whore’s forehead” of verse 3 is plain to see: the dark prayer mark worn on the forehead from bowing the head to the ground before that other god. And yet the people call it Islam and hold it up as good for the black man. Your fellow Arab Muslims are selling our people on open slave markets, and a stone cannot save you in the time of your trouble.

precepts.label: Leviticus 26:1
precepts.why:
God’s law says it plainly: “Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.” Make no idols, no graven images, and no image of stone to bow down to.

This is what our people do. We go all the way to Mecca to kiss a rock, the Kaaba stone. And they say, we don’t worship the Kaaba stone. Yes, you do. Their own ruling says it: kissing the black stone is an act of worship, done by a Muslim who has no connection to that stone except worshiping Allah by venerating it and following the messenger by doing it. That is bowing down to an image of stone, the very thing the law forbids.

Mecca itself was run down and raggedy in the first known photograph of the Kaaba in 1861. Then they started working with America on oil and got paid, and now people from all over the world call it beautiful. It is still a stone set up to bow down unto.

So Leviticus 26:1 shows why Jeremiah 3 calls it harlotry and polluting the land, and why Israel has a “whore’s forehead” and refuses “to be ashamed”. The Most High is the Lord our God, and he is not in a black stone in Arabia.

thread.label: Jeremiah 17:4
thread.text: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn

classes.title: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.label: Jeremiah 9:2-3
precepts.why:
“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. Even Jeremiah, who was not a wicked man, still went into captivity and had to deal with the same things as all the wicked Israelites. And look at how Jeremiah felt about his people, knowing how wicked we are.

“Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” Far away in the wilderness, just to get away from these people. They look just like him and he grew up with them, but he wants to get away from them. Why? “for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.”

“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Do black people do a lot of lying? Yes, we do. “but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.” They move from evil to evil and they do not know God.

That is the black Christian. Do not let them fool you. They can quote the popular scriptures all day, John 3:16, neither Jew nor Greek, no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and say God got me. No, Satan got you. You and Satan are like my buddy and me. That is why the Lord says Israel shall discontinue from its heritage and serve its enemies in a land it knew not: a people who know him not.

precepts.label: Sirach 17:11
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says Israel “shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not”. We have lost our heritage and we serve our enemies, one of the curses. Who are our enemies? All the other nations, the enemies of God. Christians do not want to hear that, but here we are unapologetically biblical. Take it up with God.

What is the heritage we lost? “Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” The law of life is the heritage we lost in Jeremiah 17. To take it, they had to break our bands asunder and separate us.

Rudolph R. Windsor, in From Babylon to Timbuktu, made mention that the Israelite culture is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you also discontinue from your heritage. We have a certain way of life as a certain people. When they strip you of your identity, what follows is your laws, statutes and commandments: you are not going to be performing the laws. Lose the identity and the heritage, the law of life, goes with it.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 8:6
precepts.why:
Ezra prayed, “O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it”. Another word for culture is heritage: the same heritage Israel discontinued from in Jeremiah 17, the law of life.

The Psalmist shows it: “If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” The right hand is your strength, what you work with. And Moses says, “from his right hand went a fiery law for them.” If you forget your identity, your way of life goes with it.

“If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.” Forget the law and you cannot speak it; your tongue is stuck. Try to talk with your tongue cleaving to the roof of your mouth and you sound crazy. That is how Christians sound to those who know the Bible, with their doctrines; to other Christians they sound fine. We cannot prefer Jerusalem as our chief joy if we do not know we are the Israelites, so we become ordained ministers from the white man's theology schools and seminaries, and we sound like idiots.

So culture to our understanding is what we need back: the identity and the laws that go with it, so that fruit may come of it.

thread.label: Jeremiah 22:13
thread.text: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

classes.title: Esau the Hater, Liar, and Killer

precepts.label: Habakkuk 2:18
precepts.why:
Woe, meaning destruction, is on him that builds his house by unrighteousness, and Habakkuk shows what that house is built on: “What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?”

So they practise idolatry. They have statues, and they bow down to them. The Bible says there is no profit in those things. A graven image is a teacher of lies, and the man who makes it trusts in the work of his own hands, a dumb idol that cannot speak.

That is the church of Esau, the hater, liar and killer. I can never understand how somebody in this modern day and age can be a Catholic: the same church that enslaved you, the same church that has statues all over the place. You can clearly read the Bible and say that this is not the way.

The house built by unrighteousness, by slavery and by robbing and pillaging countries, and the church of statues are the same house. The teacher of lies stands in the middle of it, and the woe of Jeremiah is on all of it.

precepts.label: Luke 20:38
precepts.why:
Christ says of his Father: “For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.” So the Most High is not the God of the dead.

That church, with its statues all over the place that the people bow down to, is the church of the dead, because they worship the dead. They pray to dead men and graven images, the dumb idols Habakkuk calls a teacher of lies, and the God of Israel is not in that.

It is the same church that enslaved us and built its house by unrighteousness, the house Jeremiah pronounces woe upon: “Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong”. A people who worship the dead cannot be serving the living God, and that is why a so-called Black Catholic should come out of it. The God of the living is the God of the ones who keep his word, not the God of the statues.

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:1-4
thread.text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

classes.title: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:64
precepts.why:
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” Jeremiah 23 really talks about the essence of hirelings. How do they scatter the sheep? In Christianity they scatter them into the Baptist church, the Catholic church, the holiness church, whatever denomination. We are being divided rather than united as the twelve tribes of Israel. Even in the time of Christ there were the Sadducees, the Pharisees, the Stoics, the Epicureans and the Herodians; we were being scattered then, and it's happening today.

Moses said where it would lead: “And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” Under these wood gods, like Christianity with the old wooden cross, and the many denominations under Islam, our people are scattered everywhere in those false religions, even in Judaism.

Remember, this is about Israelites; it is not so much talking about Esau. “Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away”: driven them away from the truth that they are the Israelites of the twelve tribes. But the Lord says “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them”.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 3:15
precepts.why:
Against the hirelings who scatter the flock, the Lord promises “I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking”. Jeremiah shows what they will feed us with: “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.”

Knowledge and understanding of what? God's laws. It isn't talking about feeding them with jumping up and down, screaming and foaming at the mouth.

Right now we are lacking as a race, as a people. We are lacking knowledge, wisdom and understanding; and when you break it down, we are lacking rulership, dominion of the earth, our own country, a fortified family, a nation. We are lacking everything. Pastors after God's heart, feeding us the laws, are the shepherds who end that lack.

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:1-15
thread.text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

classes.title: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.label: Matthew 15:24
precepts.why:
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” These pastors are wicked as hell. They are about nothing but money; they support wickedness, the fake Israelis and the falsehood called democracy. But the question is: who are the sheep of God's pasture?

Christ answers it: “I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” The sheep is the house of Israel. The sheep are not all nations on the planet: not the white man, not the Arab man, not the Chinese man. The only sheep are the twelve tribes of Israel.

So when you hear pastors say God is gathering his sheep and they are talking about Baptists, Catholics, Episcopalians and Anglicans, they have it all wrong. The pastors have destroyed and scattered the sheep, which is the house of Israel. “Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away”: some pastors are Baptist and take one group of our people, some are African Methodist Episcopal and take another group, some are Catholic and take another. That is how they scatter God's flock and drive them away from the knowledge of the one true God, and God says, “behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings”.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 3:15
precepts.why:
God says, “And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them”. The flock has been scattered in all countries since the time of slavery: from the Assyrians, Babylonians, Persians and Medes, Greeks and Romans, to Spain, France, England and now America. God drove them there, and he will “bring them again to their folds”, their tribes, “and they shall be fruitful and increase.”

“And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them”. Feed them what? Grits and honey? Pork chops and chitlins? No. Jeremiah 3:15 tells what they will be fed: “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.”

That is the difference between the pastors of Jeremiah 23 who scatter and the shepherds God sets up. The shepherds feed the people with knowledge and understanding, and then “they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.”

precepts.label: Malachi 2:7
precepts.why:
The shepherds God sets up feed his people “with knowledge and understanding.” Knowledge and understanding of what? Malachi breaks it down: “For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.”

There is that word knowledge again, and it is joined to the law. God's knowledge is his law. So the shepherds of Jeremiah 23:4 feed the flock with God's laws.

That is exactly what the pastors of today do not do. They teach that the law is done away with, and so both prophet and priest are profane: treating what is holy as common and unclean, defiling and polluting God's name, his Sabbath and his sanctuary. The true shepherd's lips keep the law, and the people seek it at his mouth.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:9-10
precepts.why:
“Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.” That righteous Branch is Christ, and he will execute judgment and justice in the earth. That is how you know the white man does not want Christ to come back: he has never executed justice in his life, because if he did he would have to start with himself first.

What is justice for the white man, who had a big part in our enslavement and destruction? “If any man have an ear, let him hear. He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: the white man led us into captivity. “he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword”: they killed millions upon millions of us with the sword. “Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.”

Ask our people in the Baptist, Mormon and Episcopal churches if they want justice and they say yes. Read them Revelation 13:10 and they say no, no, not that Jesus justice. They want the soft-spoken kind that gives the white man a pass: we can be judged, but not the white man.

But Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah went into captivity; Ezekiel went; Mordecai and Esther were in captivity, and they were righteous. So when they say there are some good white folks, even the ones you think are good are going into captivity. And the Arabs who stole North Africa and raped, robbed and pillaged will get justice too.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 6:13
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says, “Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets”: the pastors who destroy and scatter the sheep. “For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness”. In the prophets of Jerusalem he saw “an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies”. The whole church system of Christianity is lies: Jesus born December 25th, Jesus a white man, Mary never having relations with Joseph, the ever virgin who never had children. All lies. “they strengthen also the hands of evildoers”: the white man can do no wrong.

Jeremiah 6:13 shows the root of it: “For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.”

Everyone is given to covetousness, so we all have to be mindful of that covetous spirit, especially among the prophets, the pastors and the shepherds. All these pastors deal falsely, and God says “they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.”

precepts.label: Micah 3:11-12
precepts.why:
Micah shows why the pastors deal falsely: “The heads thereof judge for reward”: the leaders of our people want payback, money. “and the priests thereof teach for hire”: they only teach you for hire; that is how they get their theology degrees. “and the prophets thereof divine for money”: they give you a word of knowledge only if you pay.

“yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.” Why do they say that? Because of all the money they accumulated. These pastors are evil men, and now you have to add evil women, because now there are women pastors. That was unheard of. The only time you hear of women being pastors is in the worship of false gods like Diana of the Ephesians. That is why Paul told those same women to keep silence in the church: they came from worshipping Diana, where the women were the mouthpiece.

“Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps”. Zion, our country, was plowed as a field because of these heads, priests and prophets, the same judgment Jeremiah 23 says came on Israel because of the profane prophets and priests.

precepts.label: Zechariah 11:5
precepts.why:
“Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty”. The possessors who slay us are the white man; he possesses us. You may not have chains on your neck, so you think you are free, but you are not. They slay us and hold themselves not guilty: in a large majority of the cases the white man who killed our brothers and sisters was found not guilty.

“and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord”. The white man sold us and says blessed be the Lord, because he took the covenant of God in his mouth, calling himself Christian and Jew. “for I am rich”: through the selling of blacks and Latinos he became rich.

“and their own shepherds pity them not.” Our own leaders, our own pastors, do not care about us. That is the pastor of Jeremiah 23 who strengthens the hands of evildoers. The black church says it stands for righteousness, holiness and the word of God, and that is a lie. The white man himself says the black church is heretical and should go find a white church to hear the real gospel, and black apologists agree with him. If the black church stood for the truth and organized for justice, the FBI would have harassed and shut it down like every other group that stood up for black and brown people. But it stands for nothing except feed me: money, money, money.

precepts.label: Matthew 28:19-20
precepts.why:
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” “Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them”. The pastors keep the confusion and the sin in the black community going. They keep Ephraim separated from Judah; our bands are cast asunder, and they are not bringing it back. They are furthering the scattering of the children of Israel, not bringing us together.

So look what Christ had to come and say: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”. Why all nations? Because we are scattered in all nations, and the pastors are furthering the scattering. Christ sends his disciples out to the scattered sheep in every country, “Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you”: the very commandments the pastors say are done away with.

That is the other half of Jeremiah 23: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds”, “And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them”. Where the pastors scatter and teach that the law is gone, the Lord sends shepherds to go into all nations and teach his people to observe everything he commanded.

precepts.label: Matthew 15:12-14
precepts.why:
The prophets of Jerusalem “strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness”. When Jamal Bryant was checked over his wife's dress, he did not say the Bible does say a woman should dress modestly, I was in error, I repent. He doubled down: I ain't wrong. So when we see his congregants on the street and say, sis, you can't wear pants, brother, you can't sell drugs, they double down just like him. That is the evil example. None return from their wickedness; they say the Lord did away with that, you twisted the scripture.

Christ cut the Pharisees the same way. His disciples said, “Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?” He answered, “Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.” These pastors, these so-called men of the cloth, have to go; they will be rooted up.

“Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.” The pastor and the congregation both fall. So leave these lying churches alone. If they will not repent, leave them alone. God says of them, “they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah”, and he “will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall”.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 22:25-27
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says “both prophet and priest are profane”. Ezekiel shows what that looks like: “There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls”. These pastors devour your souls. “they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof”, through adultery.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean”. They blurred the lines. There is no right or wrong now, just a grey area in the middle: do a little evil, a little good, everything is grey. “and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.”

“Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.” The black Christian congregants are the prey. It is money, money, money; covetousness is what they are. Juanita Bynum can charge over a thousand dollars for a prayer class and be that bold because the black community does not know the Bible.

That is the profaneness Jeremiah says has “gone forth into all the land” from the prophets. Teaching prosperity and that the laws of God are done away produces adulterers, gangbangers, murderers and debauchery, and the land is full of adulterers because of it.

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:5-8
thread.text: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

classes.title: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.label: Zechariah 2:6-8
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the Lord will lead “the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them”. Zechariah gives the call to come out: “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”. The north country is North America; flee from North America.

“for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord”. We are not just in North America. That is why Jeremiah says “from all countries whither I had driven them”: the 12 tribes were scattered to every corner, and the gathering is from all of them.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Who is that? Judah. That is the “Judah shall be saved” of Jeremiah 23, where in the days of the righteous Branch, Christ, Judah is saved and Israel dwells safely; remember we were split into two kingdoms.

“for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” Meaning we are his favorite. We are God's favorite. And the end of it is “they shall dwell in their own land”. That is what we are lacking: we don't have our own land. The Lord who brought Israel out of Egypt will be known as the Lord who brought his favorite people out of the north country and set them in their own land.

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:9-15
thread.text: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.

classes.title: Living Your Life As A Hireling

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:16-20
thread.text: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.

classes.title: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.label: Acts 14:22
precepts.why:
“They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace”. They are speaking to people who really hate God. At the sit down, the man with the hat kept saying that when tribulation comes, we're not going to be here; the church won't be here. Christians just lie and tell you there's going to be peace.

But Paul and Barnabas were “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” The only way we're entering the kingdom of God is through much tribulation. So what Bible are these Christians reading?

That is why Jeremiah says “Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.” A vision of their own heart is their own mind, what they feel at that moment: I don't know who this is for, but God has a message for you. It is not coming from the Bible, and the Bible says tribulation.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 4:27-31
precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you. And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.”

In all the lands we were scattered, “if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul”, meaning do everything God says to do. “When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice; (For the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee”.

When thou art in tribulation, even in the latter days: so these Christians don't know what they are talking about when they say the church won't be here. Israel is in tribulation in the latter days, and Jeremiah said “in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.” Our people will not repent unless they get a foot up their behind; death makes people reconsider their ways. We say we are Christians, we serve the same God, and the white man doesn't give a damn about that. But the Lord is merciful: seek him with all the heart and he will not forsake us nor forget the covenant of our fathers.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 7:13-18
precepts.why:
“For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.” The elder world was during the time of Adam. Ezra says “the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish. Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide”. Strait things is tribulation.

So all Israel is going to go through tribulation, the righteous and the unrighteous. “they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.” The false prophets say “No evil shall come upon you”, but “a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury”, and it will not return until he has performed the thoughts of his heart.

What we see on the news, death after death, is just the beginning. A young black girl tied to a tree with a ratchet strap, the kind trucks use to hold down wood, and they call it suicide. Tonya Miller, 27, and Juliana Enza, 16, found hanging from trees, ruled suicides; look at all these names. They can insult our intelligence with this because we are not unified and not connected to the Lord; there is no consequence. They don't do it to the Chinese or Japanese. And it is not only the men: all you independent women, get ready. I don't see color; well, color sees you. It's going to escalate. They won't ask what God you serve: you're in the image of God, and they will come for all the melanated brothers and sisters. The righteous suffer the strait things and hope for the wide.

thread.label: Jeremiah 23:21-32
thread.text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

classes.title: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.label: Numbers 12:6-8
precepts.why:
“I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.” He did not send these pastors, these Christian reverends. Yet they ran: I am going to build a church here. I have not spoken to them: when they say God spoke to me, it is a lie. And “I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.”

How did the Lord speak to his prophets? “Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.” “My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.” “With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold”.

The only one the Lord spoke with mouth to mouth was Moses. So when you hear black women go, God told me: God told you nothing. Stop lying. The Lord spoke to me this morning, his voice was so clear: that is a lie. But people believe this crap.

Miriam said God spoke to her too, and she was a prophet, and the Lord answered, “wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” If even a true prophet was rebuked for putting herself beside Moses, what about these pastors who say God spoke to them? They should have stood in his counsel and caused the people to hear his words; that is the only way to turn the people from their evil way, and you can only transform them with the Bible, the commandments of God.

thread.label: Jeremiah 25:28-31
thread.text: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

classes.title: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

thread.label: Jeremiah 30:1-7
thread.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

precepts.label: Joel 3:1
precepts.why:
“Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.” That book is called the Bible today. Then pay attention: “For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah”.

Joel 3:1 confuses some brothers: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”. Read that alone and you think it means he is bringing us back into slavery. That is not what it means.

Go back to Jeremiah 30:3. Notice the same words, except Jeremiah explains them: “and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.” When he says he will bring again the captivity, he is speaking of bringing us back from captivity, not into captivity. Jeremiah explains Joel.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 9:2-3
precepts.why:
“We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.” We are coming up on that moment now. And yet our people cheer the movies on Martin Luther King and Malcolm X. You may not agree with Martin's method, but how many of us would walk down the street knowing we would be beaten, jailed and have dogs sicced on us? Their stand ended Jim Crow, and in sixty years of that liberty, how have we used it? We shoot each other, besmirch one another and hate each other.

Jeremiah said, “Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” He wanted to leave black people. Why? “for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men. And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Black people love to use their lips for lies.

“but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth”. They are valiant in the movie theatre. They cheer on Nat Turner in Birth of a Nation, cheer on Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, cheer the resistance in The Hunger Games and Star Wars, but they do not have that spirit and do not have the balls to do what those men did. They would never have joined Malcolm or Martin, and many will not join us out of fear. Two young boys got shot in the face in Georgia, instigated by a gaggle of other black men who scattered like cockroaches and played innocent when the cops came. So-called revolutionary brothers on podcasts call us a cult while including homosexuality and transgenderism; they have never left the couch.

“for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.” That is why, in the time of Jacob's trouble, there is a voice of trembling and fear and not of peace.

thread.label: Jeremiah 30:7
thread.text: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

classes.title: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

thread.label: Jeremiah 30:8-11
thread.text: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

precepts.label: Hosea 3:4-5
precepts.why:
“In that day”, “I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him”: that's Christ's return. “But they shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.” Uh-oh. Did you notice? David is alive.

Hosea says the same: “For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim”. Many days without a king. “Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.”

We are returning now. We are seeking the Lord our God. And it is telling you David is going to be alive in these last days, in the latter days, when Israel returns. That is the day of Jeremiah 30, when the yoke is broken off our neck and the Lord raises David up unto us.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 1:11
precepts.why:
If David is alive in these last days, “David their king, whom I will raise up unto them”, why doesn't anyone know it? Solomon says: “There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.”

David will not remember who he is, and neither do you. Our minds are wiped, everybody. We don't know who's who. That is why it says love your neighbour as you love yourself: you don't know who is who.

And that is a good thing. In the old school we used to say, oh, this one's David, and that caused a lot of partiality and a lot of problems. Don't do that. Don't try to guess who anybody is either. Little brother calling himself Samson: you don't know, brother. Just stop it. The Lord will raise up David; it is not ours to name him.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 34:23
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says Israel “shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.” Ezekiel says the same of the last days: “And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.”

One shepherd over the whole nation, and that shepherd is David. After Israel has abided many days without a king, the Lord himself sets David up over them, to feed them.

That is part of the promise that comes at the end of the exile and tribulation: the yoke broken from our neck, the strangers no longer serving themselves of us, Jacob returned to rest and quiet with none to make him afraid, and one shepherd, David, raised up over Israel under the Lord their God.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 9:22
precepts.why:
“though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee”. Why is he going to make an end of all nations? Ezra says it: “Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain”.

All these nations were born in vain. In a movie they are the extras; they're not the stars of the movie. We are. And Esau is the villain, the antagonist, the bad guy.

But the stars are not spared from correction: “I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.” The Lord makes a full end of the nations, but only corrects Israel in measure. So “fear thou not, O my servant Jacob”. What he says will happen would make anyone afraid, and nobody wants to go through tribulation, so we increase our faith by reminding ourselves that this body is just a shell; the real us is within. He will save us from afar, and Jacob shall return and be in rest, and none shall make him afraid.

thread.label: Jeremiah 30:12-17
thread.text: For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.

precepts.label: Isaiah 1:4-6
precepts.why:
“Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous. There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.” None stands up on our behalf, and we have no healing medicine. Every Negro that just popped out of his mama's behind has a new idea for how to save black people, and it is always economics or voting. Those medicines don't work. What is the wound? Our sins. Isaiah says the same thing.

“Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.” We are that sinful nation, a people laden with sin; iniquity is sin. He calls us a seed of evildoers.

“Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more”. Our people get punished and revolt more and more against God. Then: “the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint”: the whole head of the Israelites is sick.

“From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.” Neither mollified with ointment means no medicine: there is no healing for us that way. That is Jeremiah's “no healing medicines.”

The only one who can save us is the Saviour, Jesus Christ, our master, our king. Yes, he is our rabbi, and rabbi means master. The wound Jeremiah calls incurable is incurable by any remedy of men; only the Lord can say, “I will restore health unto thee”.

precepts.label: Job 2:7
precepts.why:
What Isaiah and Jeremiah say of the nation is the same thing Job went through. People read Job and think that was only him, but Job's real life symbolizes the nation of Israel. This was the fifth judgment on Job: “So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.” Didn't we just read that in Isaiah 1? “From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it”.

Job's life is Deuteronomy 28. He lost his businesses, his family, everything. And “There is none to plead thy cause”: Job had friends who would not stand up on his behalf. They were always telling him he was wrong, evil, the devil. There was no cure; God had to intervene and heal Job. That is why the Lord sent Christ to heal the twelve tribes of Israel.

Even Job's wife turned on him in his darkest moment, when he had lost everything. That is how these black women do with us: in this state, the black woman turned on us.

But at the end of Job's life he was blessed. That is what is going to happen to us if we endure to the end: the incurable wound of Jeremiah 30 ends with “I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds”.

precepts.label: Leviticus 26:41
precepts.why:
“I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.” Our sins are increased: the Houston rodeo, black men and women whoring themselves out, filthy and wicked, so bad a dress code had to be put in place; and in Delta State in Nigeria, a festival where women are openly raped in the streets. That is evil. Then: “because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee”.

Moses said it would be so: “And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies”. God walked contrary to us because we kept breaking his laws, and he brought us into the land of our enemies. Then what we must do: “if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity”.

As we repent, we have to accept that God is right and we are wrong. We have always been wrong. God was just when he punished us. When your child plays in the street or with the light socket, you beat that behind, not because you hate him but so he learns he'll die playing in traffic or with electricity. Some talking doesn't do any good for some kids; you have to rile up on them so they know it's serious. That is what God did with us.

The three holy children did exactly this. In the midst of the fiery furnace, cast in because they would not worship Babylon's god, Azarias prayed: “Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers”, “For thou art righteous in all the things that thou hast done to us: yea, true are all thy works, thy ways are right, and all thy judgments truth.” Then: “for according to truth and judgment didst thou bring all these things upon us because of our sins. For we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from thee”. Everything God has done to our people is justified, because we revolted against him. They said it because of what Moses said in Leviticus, and what happened to them is a reflection of what will happen to us.

Christianity has taught our people the opposite: to mock a God who got angry at his own people for worshipping a golden calf. But accepting the punishment is the way back, because the next verse is: “Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob”.

precepts.label: Luke 9:11
precepts.why:
“For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord”. The Lord is the only one who can restore health; that goes back to verses 12 and 13, “thou hast no healing medicines.” There is no magic voting right and no economic situation to save us.

Luke shows who the healer is: “And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.” Christ spake of the kingdom and healed them that had need of healing. He is the only one who can heal us of all these things. He is the Saviour; he is the physician.

That is how the incurable bruise of Jeremiah 30 is cured. Not by any medicine of man, but by the Lord who received the people, taught them the kingdom of God, and healed them.

precepts.label: Mark 2:17
precepts.why:
Christ is the physician: “When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick”. If you think you're good, that you know everything, you don't need the son of God, you don't need the Saviour.

You have to admit you're sick: that we are in the midst of sin, and that all we have done has been wrong. That is the same thing as accepting the punishment of our iniquity.

“I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.” He did not call us righteous. He came for sinners. That is the healing Jeremiah promises Israel, whose “sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity”. The sick nation is the one he came to heal.

The churches are the opposite: they say they don't need that Bible, they are already whole. Isaiah 65 shows them saying so, “I am holier than thou.” The ones who think themselves whole will not come to the physician.

precepts.label: Isaiah 65:1-5
precepts.why:
This goes with Christ saying he came not for the righteous but for sinners. “I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not”. Like the disciples, we didn't wake up one day as kids searching for the Lord of heaven and earth. The word was introduced to us and woke us up.

“I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” We are called African-Americans, Haitians, Jamaicans, Puerto Ricans. That is a nation not called by his name.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. We are that rebellious people, walking in Christianity and Islam, our people following their own thoughts in these religions. “A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick”: the churches and mosques. Then: “which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels”. You know that's the church: there was always a swine fest at the end, pig feet and all of that; possum soup, turtle soup.

“Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.” That is what the churches say to the Israelites on the street preaching: stand by yourself, I don't need no black Jesus, I'm washed in the blood of Jesus, I'm water baptized, I'm holier than thou. “These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.” God can't stand them.

That is the people Jeremiah calls an Outcast, “This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.” Those who think they are whole push away the physician; the sick who admit it are the ones he heals.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 2:24
precepts.why:
How does the Lord restore health unto us? “Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.”

Christ bare our sins in his own body on the tree, which is the cross; the cross was made from a tree. We, being dead to sin, should live unto righteousness. We are healed by Christ's punishment, his crucifixion.

That is the prophecy of Jeremiah 30:17: “For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord”. How? When he sent Christ to die on the cross. By his stripes we are healed.

Then: “because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after”. Outcast means African-American: made-up names they gave our race. Nobody gives a damn about you, blacks and Latinos; no man seeks after you. But the Lord does. The wound no medicine could close is healed by his stripes, and then “all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity”: every one of them, not some.

thread.label: Jeremiah 30:18-24
thread.text: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

precepts.label: Numbers 1:52
precepts.why:
Just before this, the Lord says, “I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds”, and that healing came when he sent Christ to die on the cross: by his stripes we are healed. “because they called thee an Outcast”: outcast means African-American, made-up names for our race, a Zion “whom no man seeketh after”. Nobody gives a damn about blacks and Latinos. Then: “Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents”.

What are Jacob’s tents? “And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.” Every man by his own camp: Judah is going to be with Judah, Ephraim with Ephraim, Benjamin with Benjamin. That is the restructuring, the restoration of a nation.

And every man by his own standard: Judah had the standard of the lion, Benjamin the wolf, Naphtali the deer, Ephraim the bull. When the Lord brings again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, all of this is being restored again: the tribes set back in order, each under its own standard.

precepts.label: Numbers 24:5
precepts.why:
All of this is being restored again: “How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!”

The tents of Jacob, pitched every man by his own camp and his own standard, are goodly in the eyes of the Lord. These are the same tents Jeremiah speaks of when the Lord says, “I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces”.

So the promise of Jeremiah 30:18 is that the goodly order Israel had in the wilderness, the tribes camped in their tents, is brought back out of captivity. What was taken captive, the Lord returns, and Jacob’s tents are goodly again.

precepts.label: Psalms 78:55
precepts.why:
“He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.” He cast out the heathen before us, divided the land to the tribes by line, and set each tribe in its tents.

That is what it means for the Lord to bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents. The tents of Jacob are the tribes of Israel dwelling in their own inheritance, and to bring them again is to cast out the heathen once more and set the twelve tribes back in their inheritance.

Then Jeremiah goes on: “and the city shall be builded upon her own heap”, because that land is going to be destroyed and built again, and the tribes dwell in it again as the Lord made them to dwell at the first.

precepts.label: Isaiah 60:10-13
precepts.why:
“the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.” It says heap because that land is going to be destroyed and built again; the palace means the temple that is going to be built. Isaiah 60 goes with Jeremiah 30:18.

“And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.” The strangers build the walls when Jerusalem is built again on her own heap.

“The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary”. That is the palace. “and I will make the place of my feet glorious”: the Lord is going to make Jerusalem glorious again.

precepts.label: Isaiah 60:21-22
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says, “I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.” That is why we go to Isaiah 60.

“Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.” Then: “A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.” We shall not be small.

There is more in that verse than what it is saying on the surface. Look at the little bodies we have now. We are not going to have these little bodies. We are not going to be all frail and skinny, and the little fat brothers are not going to be like that either. The Lord multiplies and glorifies Israel, in number and in body.

precepts.label: Isaiah 1:25-26
precepts.why:
“Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me”. The Lord is going to return it all back to the way it was.

Isaiah says the same: “And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:” “And I will restore thy judges as at the first”. He purges the dross out of Israel and restores the judges as at the first, the way it was in the beginning.

That is what Jeremiah 30:20 is saying: our children as aforetime, our congregation established before the Lord, everything returned to our glorious state. And it answers verse 21 too, “their nobles shall be of themselves”: our own judges, restored as at the first.

precepts.label: Zechariah 12:7-8
precepts.why:
“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.” These are the same tents of Jacob that the Lord brings again out of captivity.

“In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David”. The feeble Israelites are going to be like King David. “and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.” The house of David is the 144,000; they shall be as God.

That is our children being as aforetime and our glorious state being restored: the Lord saving Judah’s tents first, and the weakest of Israel made as strong as David.

precepts.label: Psalms 72:4
precepts.why:
At the bottom of Jeremiah 30:20 the Lord says, “I will punish all that oppress them.” He said all, not some. All that have oppressed us shall be punished.

The precept is Psalms 72: “He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.” Break in pieces the oppressor.

There is no coming together and joining with the oppressor. The Lord did not say he would reconcile Israel with the ones who oppressed them; he said, I am going to break them. That is the punishment of all that oppress us.

precepts.label: Matthew 2:6
precepts.why:
“And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them”. Our nobles are going to come from our own people. We are not going to have nobles of another race, like the mayor they have now in New York, Mamdani. That is not our people.

Christ is our governor, and he came from the midst of us: “And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.” That is Christ right there.

So the governor that proceeds from the midst of Israel is Christ, born in Bethlehem of Judah, ruling his people Israel. “I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me”, and then, “ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.”

thread.label: Jeremiah 31:31-37
thread.text: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

classes.title: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

precepts.label: Hebrews 8:8-10
precepts.why:
Paul quotes this straight from Jeremiah: “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah”. Christians avoid that, because when you ask them who the new covenant is for, it tells you crystal clear right there who it was for: the house of Israel and the house of Judah. He separates us like that because there was a split into two kingdoms, and when he says Israel right there, he means all 12 tribes.

“Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt”. That was the old covenant, animal sacrifice. The 12 tribes are the bride and God is the husband. “because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord”: meaning we went into slavery.

“I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people”. This is kingdom, the same promise Jeremiah gave. So this is the answer to replacement theology, the answer to supersessionism. The new covenant was never given to a church that took Israel's place; it was made with the same Israel that broke the first one.

And Jeremiah goes on to seal it: if the ordinances of the sun, the moon and the stars depart, then the seed of Israel ceases from being a nation. They have not departed, so the 12 tribes are still here to this day. Even in Paul's time the 12 tribes were there, yet Christians cannot point them out in the New Testament and say they are lost. It's all a lie. This is where Paul was getting it from.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 4:13
precepts.why:
Paul writes to Timothy: “The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.” The books means the books of Isaiah, the books of Jeremiah, the books of Micah. It is not talking about books about how to braid your hair.

“but especially the parchments”: parchments are writing papers. Paul would read the Old Testament books and base his epistles on those writings. That is why Hebrews 8 carries the new covenant word for word out of Jeremiah 31: Paul was reading Jeremiah and writing from it.

So the New Testament does not replace the Old; it is built on it. When Jeremiah says the new covenant is with the house of Israel and the house of Judah, and that the seed of Israel will not cease from being a nation while the sun, moon and stars stand, Paul was taking that from the prophets he carried with him. The church did not get a new covenant of its own; Paul was teaching Israel's covenant out of Israel's books.
