thread.label: Jeremiah 50:1-20
thread.text: The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

precepts.label: Luke 5:36-39
precepts.why:
“My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.” The shepherds, the pastors, lead our people from one religion to another, and they have forgotten their restingplace, the word of God. Pastors charged with rape and child abuse, a pastor arrested on counts of rape of girls thirteen and fifteen, two pastors charged in the murder for hire of a blind, mentally disabled man for insurance money: that is how the shepherds have caused them to go astray. Yet Christians do not want to change, just as the Pharisees did not want to change.

Christ told them a parable: “No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.” Christ is the piece of new garment; the new covenant was being ushered in and they were not ready for it. It agreed not with the old covenant: animal sacrifice was replaced by the sacrifice of Christ.

“And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish. But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.” The new wine is the new covenant in Christ. The new bottles are us being born again: new creatures, new men, new women.

“No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.” That is how the Pharisees and scribes felt about Christ's teaching, and so it is today with Christians and the true teaching of Christ and the Israelites. Our people like their old ways and old traditions, and when we bring them the new covenant in Christ by keeping the commandments, they say, I don't want that. So “their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.”

thread.label: Jeremiah 50:6
thread.text: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

thread.label: Jeremiah 50:7

thread.label: Jeremiah 50:21-46

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:5
precepts.why:
Jeremiah 50 ends with the hammer of the whole earth broken: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”. The least of the flock is the so-called Israelis, that tiny speck in the midst of the brown and black nations. They bomb Qatar during peace talks, cry help us, and America comes to their rescue. “surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them”: America desolate, and little Israel over there wiped out too. “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.”

Then chapter 51 turns to us: “For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts”. That means us. It might seem like we have been forsaken because we are down and out, at the bottom. But Israel has not been forsaken, because of the covenant the Lord made with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and he sent his Son Christ to die for our sins.

“though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.” Even in the midst of our sin he has not forsaken us. That is the same mercy the class read in Isaiah 14:1, the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will yet choose Israel, and nobody has anything to say about it. He is not having mercy on all nations or pardoning all nations; while Babylon, the hammer, is broken, Israel and Judah are kept.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:41-49
precepts.why:
“How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised!” Sheshach is another name for Babylon. America is the praise of the whole earth; everybody has God bless America. “how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!” All the nations will be shocked when she goes down.

“The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.” The sea is the nations. Ezekiel says it: “will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.” “Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.” That has not happened yet; it is yet to come.

“And I will punish Bel in Babylon”. Bel was a false god, and the Bel of today is Cesare Borgia, the god of Babylon. “and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him”: in Daniel 2 the last kingdom was a mix of all nations, and that is America. God will put an end to that. “yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.”

“My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Revelation 18:4 says the same: come out of her, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues, those nuclear bombs. Come out of Christmas, Easter, Kwanzaa, Memorial Day and all the foolishness done here, and return to the one true God by keeping his commandments.

“And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour”. Do not give up. A rumour is something heard and talked about that has not occurred yet: World War III and Armageddon are the rumour now, the wars and rumours of wars of Matthew 24:6. Then “violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” “Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north”, as the whole earth breaks forth into singing in Isaiah 14:7. “As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.”

thread.label: Jeremiah 50:23
thread.text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

classes.title: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:7
precepts.why:
“How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!” This Babylon is America, and the hammer of the whole earth is America, the oppressor. The same way the Lord used Nebuchadnezzar to judge Israel and all the nations, he uses America in these last days to beat all nations into subjection and bring judgment on them. America is no longer acting as Lucifer, the one about peace, justice and rights; it is turning back into who it really is, and it will oppress all nations, including Europe.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”. In whose hand? The Lord's. The Lord is the one using Babylon. Everything Babylon does, everything Trump is doing on the earth today, is because the Lord wants it done. “that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine”. That wine is oppression, affliction, falsehood, lies and deceit: the same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to make all nations drink.

“therefore the nations are mad.” Europe, China, Russia, Iran, the Arab nations, Venezuela: they are angry. America went into a sovereign country, took its leader, brought him back on drug charges and had four billion dollars' worth of oil shipped over. That is the cup, and Venezuela will not be the only one to drink it; even if they do not want to, the Lord will make them drink.

That is why the hammer will be greatly despised and broken. This is the beginning of sorrows; the world has changed and it is not going to get better. Prepare your mind and your spirit, and stop being caught up in sin.

thread.text: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

classes.title: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.label: Zechariah 2:6
precepts.why:
“The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say”. The violence done to us, the Israelites, will be upon Babylon, and the Babylon here is America. But who is Zion, and where is Zion dwelling? Zechariah shows it is not just talking about the past, what Nebuchadnezzar did to us; it is talking about the future.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” The land of the north is America. Read on: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” And in Psalms 137 the daughter of Babylon is Edom. So Zion, the Israelites, is dwelling with white people in the land of the north, in America.

That means the violence in Jeremiah 51:35 is violence they will do to us in this land, and that blood will be upon them. Then: “Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee”. As we pray and ask him for vengeance and mercy, the Lord pleads our cause and takes vengeance on America for what they are doing to our people. So brothers, I know you are mad at what you see happening outside, but the Lord said he will take vengeance for us. “I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry. And Babylon shall become heaps”: a burnt heap.

Until then, Zion must deliver herself: stop the porn, the fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy, serve God and get right.

thread.label: Jeremiah 51:46
thread.text: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

classes.title: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.label: Matthew 24:6
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says, “And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land”. What is the rumour we will hear in the land? Christ answers it: “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”. The rumour is war.

What kind of war? Not just rumours of war in Russia or the Middle East, but rumours of America having a civil war. “a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour”: one year you will hear there might be a civil war in America, and another year you will hear it again. Then “violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” There will be violence here in the land of America, and they will not just fight each other; they will kill us in this land too, those of us who teach the gospel.

Read on: “Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon”, the graven images of Christianity, “and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.” That is civil war taking place here in Babylon. That did not happen to ancient Babylon, which fell by a coup, not by that violence.

So before that day, the Lord says, “My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Deliver your soul: stop the porn, the fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy, serve God and get right, so your heart does not faint when the rumours come.

thread.label: Lamentations 4:17
thread.text: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

precepts.label: Isaiah 30:5
precepts.why:
Lamentations says, “in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Isaiah says the same of Israel leaning on a nation: “They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

Our people watch for a nation, America, to save them. It is 2025 and we are still thinking this place is for us. What we don't understand is that the system was never built for us; it was always written against us. Think about it: when the system was built, where were we? We were in slavery. So what makes you think that same system is now going to benefit you? That was never the purpose behind it.

Donald Trump is showing you that. That is why I love Donald Trump: he is forcing the negro to see the system for exactly what it is. The system was never built for the slaves; it was always against the slaves.

So the nation Israel watched for could not profit them. It could be no help and no profit, only a shame and a reproach. Our eyes fail for a vain help as long as we look to America to save us.

thread.label: Lamentations 5:1
thread.text: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

precepts.label: Lamentations 4:17
precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Look at what is happening to us. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Bible calls these nations, particularly the white man, strangers and aliens. America takes that term and puts it on Issachar, the Mexicans, on our people from Venezuela, the tribe of Asher, and on our people from Haiti, the tribe of Levi. But they are the real aliens the Bible speaks of; they take our lands and homes.

They kill our fathers and our leaders, so “We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.” Water, which is to be free, they take, bottle and sell to us; the wood of our lands they chop up and sell as merchandise, carpentry, homes and tables. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.” Egypt had long been taken down when Jeremiah said this, so the Egyptian here means the oppressor, an oppressive state; Egypt and Assyria were both major oppressors. We have given our hand to the oppressor for him to give us bread.

Then Lamentations 4:17: “As for us”, the 12 tribes of Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” We have watched for America to save us, and God is saying, they cannot save you, just as ancient Egypt could not save us and Assyria could not save our people. We keep looking for salvation to the very nations that oppress us. God said, you are wasting your time with that thing.

precepts.label: Matthew 12:25
precepts.why:
America knows terrorists are in this country, yet it is looking at the wrong immigrants: the Mexicans, our people from Venezuela, from Haiti, from Jamaica. Those are the aliens they chase, when the real aliens are the ones who took our inheritance. And it is causing a divide in Babylon the Great. Christ said: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation”.

That started with us. When the 12 tribes split, after that split we fell, and the 12 tribes were brought to desolation, with 70 AD soon approaching. But the statement Christ made wasn't just for us. It applied to Rome, which was dominant over us at that time, and to the European nations and countries as well.

“and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand”. You could go deep with that in the house too, husbands and wives divided against each other: if your family is divided, your house is going to fall.

The prophecy shows it coming on spiritual Egypt, Babylon the Great: “And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour”. I will set the Americans against the Americans. That is a house divided, internal warfare, and there will be a civil war in this country. So the nation we watched to save us is a divided house that cannot stand, and we must not look to it for our help.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 23:13-16
precepts.why:
When Ezekiel dug in the wall, he saw “every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.” That is like putting the images of Cesare Borgia on the walls, or Guadalupe on the walls, today. Ezekiel 23 shows what they were putting on the walls: images of the gods of their enemies.

“Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way, And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion, Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea”. Israel looked at the pictures of her enemies on the wall, dressed up like princes.

“And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.” As soon as she saw them, she wanted them. That is why the Lord said in Numbers 15, when he gave us the fringes, that with your eyes you will go a whoring.

So the imagery on the walls of the temple in Ezekiel 8 was not harmless decoration. The images of other nations and their gods drew Israel's eyes, and her eyes drew her heart after them. It is the same today with the images hung on our walls, and it is why the Lord said, I cannot be around you all, and went far off from his sanctuary.

precepts.label: John 3:19
precepts.why:
Ezekiel was shown “what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The Lord seeth us not; the Lord hath forsaken the earth.” Seventy elders with censers in their hands, burning incense to the images in the dark. What do they do in the dark? What do you do in the dark? Your secrets, your secret sins.

Christ gives the judgment on it: “And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Men love the dark because their deeds are evil; they hide there because they think the Lord does not see them.

But the Lord brought Ezekiel through the hole in the wall to show him exactly what was done in the dark. Nothing done in the chambers of imagery is hidden from him. The ancients said the Lord had forsaken the earth, but it was they who had forsaken the light, and that is the condemnation.

precepts.label: Matthew 15:24
precepts.why:
“For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.” Who is that I? Christ. And Christ said who he came for: “I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

That is what Christ was doing, seeking out the lost sheep of Israel, and that is what Paul and the apostles were doing after him. That was the great commission in Matthew 28:19.

So when Ezekiel says “I will seek that which was lost”, that's our people. The lost sheep Christ was sent to are the same sheep God promised to search out and deliver “out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day”: all places, countries and lands.

precepts.label: Psalms 50:4-5
precepts.why:
Ezekiel says God will search his sheep and gather them from the countries. Who does the gathering? “He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.” He calls to the heavens from above: those are the angels he's calling to. And to the earth: the earth are the prophets, you and me on the earth.

“Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” Those are the twelve tribes of Israel. So he's telling the prophets, gather the twelve tribes, and he's telling the angels, gather the twelve tribes.

That is the promise of Ezekiel 34: “I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel.” The good pasture is the kingdom.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:31
precepts.why:
“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” These are the angels of Psalms 50, called from the heavens to gather.

Did he say gather everybody, all people? No. They gather his elect, and his elect are Israel. It's the same gathering Ezekiel spoke of: “so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.” The four winds are all the places, countries and lands where our people were scattered.

The prophets gather on the earth, the angels gather from the heavens, and it is the elect, the sheep of the house of Israel, who are gathered.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:4
precepts.why:
Who are the elect the angels gather in Matthew 24? Isaiah answers: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name.” Israel is God's elect.

So there's no contradiction between the New Testament and the Old Testament. Christ was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Israel, the angels gather the elect, and the elect is Israel. Ezekiel's sheep, Matthew's elect and Isaiah's elect are the same people.

The contradiction comes from these false pastors, these hireling pastors, who tell the people it is everybody. The Lord said: “I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick.” That's our people: we were broken, we're the sick ones. “but I will destroy the fat and the strong”: he is going to destroy the nations. “I will feed them with judgment.”

precepts.label: Psalms 149:1-5
precepts.why:
“Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.” The saints are the twelve tribes God gathers.

“Let Israel rejoice in him that made him”: because we have not been rejoicing in our creator, we've been rejoicing in the white man. “let the children of Zion be joyful in their King”: for so long we've been joyful in the white man.

“For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.” He doesn't take pleasure in all races on the planet, only in his people.

“Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.” That's the rest right there. It is what Ezekiel promised the gathered sheep: “there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel. I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.”

thread.label: Ezekiel 35:2
thread.text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

precepts.label: Genesis 36:8
precepts.why:
Moses settles who Mount Seir is: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So when the Lord tells Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,” the prophecy is against Esau, Edom. “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee” means God is against Esau-Edom.

Mount Seir itself is the place called Petra today, and nobody lives there. It is a rock with the same Roman-style structures you see on courthouses in America. God is not prophesying against a rock. He is prophesying against the people who once lived there, wherever they have gone. “I will lay thy cities waste” speaks of the other cities Esau-Edom built, which God still calls Mount Seir. “I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys” means wherever Edom is, his great governments and his smaller ones.

Then God gives the reason: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”. Perpetual means everlasting. Our people ask why white folks hate us so, when we never did anything to them. God answers: they have always hated us, because that is how he made them. We thought our iniquity had an end at the so-called emancipation, and Edom made a new thing, the KKK, whose hoods, crosses and cross-burning came out of Spain and the Spanish Inquisition, when they were murdering black people, the Jews. Look at the capirotes of Spain and the KKK: the same damn thing, the same damn group. The whites from Spain brought that dress code to America and terrorized Negroes, and Negroes ain't put one and one together yet. That is why calling Christianity white supremacy is literal.

So God has prepared him: “I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”, a violent life and a coming destruction. “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. And the boast that condemns him: “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. Those two nations are Judah and Israel, and the two countries are Israel and America: Edom took America as Christians and took the land of Israel as the Jews.

Ezekiel 36:5 makes it plain: God has spoken “against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say Japheth took the land; it says Idumea. So you're either going to go with what God said or what some negro on YouTube says. The Bible says Edom and their own scholars say Edom, so why are negroes going, no, it's Japheth? Esau put these things in his own books because he only expected his own people to read them. Their scholars agree: medieval chroniclers said Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, and Benjamin of Tudela called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, which is Christianity. This whole chapter reveals which race took the land of Israel and the land called America: Esau-Edom.

precepts.label: Revelation 2:9
precepts.why:
Ezekiel 35:12 says God has heard all Edom’s blasphemies: “I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” Christ names that same blasphemy in Revelation: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.”

That is the blasphemy: Edom took over the land and said, it is given to us, we are the Jews. They are not the Jews, and the land is not theirs. Revelation 3:9 says it again: “I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie”. They are the devil the Bible speaks of, and it is the Son of God who said it.

The verse also speaks to our people: “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. That is our poverty, but we are rich, because we are the children of God.

“Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” By calling themselves Jews and claiming the land as Jews, Edom has boasted against God, and God heard every word. So “When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate”: when all creation is singing, Edom is destroyed. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”.

Our people share in the blasphemy too. Ezekiel 36:20 says that when Israel was scattered among the heathen “they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” Every black and Latino Christian who points at the people in the land and says, those are the Jews, profanes God’s name. It was prophesied that the Messiah would come through Edom’s religion, Christianity, as a lord bent on doing away with all moral restraints: keep no commandments, keep no laws. That is the religion of Edom, and Christ is its enemy.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 36:19
precepts.why:
Ezekiel 36:5 says Idumea “appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” They were happy to steal that land. With despiteful minds means they took it knowing, despite the fact, that it was not theirs and that they are not the Jews; they took it as the Jews and said God gave them that land. To cast it out for a prey means they called their fellow Europeans from Poland, from Czechoslovakia, from Germany, from Russia, from Uzbekistan: come and get some land. That is why you have all those funny-looking people over there. Their own scholars write that Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, Rome the Edomite capital, the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, and that religion is Christianity.

Then verse 19 shows how that could happen: “And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.” We were scattered amongst the heathen, dispersed through the countries, and God judged our people for our ways.

Read on: “And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” Wherever we went, we profaned God's holy name. How? When we said to the heathen, these are the people of the Lord: those are the Jews. All Black Christians say that. All Latino Christians say that, pointing at Amalek in the land and calling them the Jews. That is how we profane God's name.

So Idumea sits in our land with despiteful minds, and our own people, scattered and judged, stand beside them and call them God's people. The land was taken by Edom, and the lie was confirmed by Israel in its Christianity.

precepts.label: Matthew 15:24
precepts.why:
Daniel says the secret was revealed not for any wisdom of his own, “but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king”, and the interpretation is the kingdom: the stone cut out without hands breaks the image of gold, silver, brass, iron and clay, and “in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”. God is raising up that kingdom right now, and it is being built among the people Christ came for.

Christ says who those people are: “But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” Christ only came for the lost sheep, and we are the lost sheep. Christ came to die for us, brothers; that was the purpose, to redeem us back to the Father.

So never think that we are not special. Christ did not come to die for everybody. He only died for the Israelites, so he could bring us back to the Father, and from there the kingdom is set up.

That is what you see right now: we are repenting and starting to know who we are, Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Simeon, coming out of that filthy Christian church, stopping the stealing and the adultery. In the middle of waking up you are going to make mistakes, but when you do, don't stay down; repent, rise back up and keep it moving, because you are the chosen. This world is darkness, and we are the light of this world. Don't turn that light off and go back to darkness; darkness has nothing to offer you but death.

precepts.label: 1 Maccabees 1:1-9
precepts.why:
Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that after the silver of Persia and Media shall come “another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.” What does it mean that this empire, the Greeks, would bear rule over all the earth? The first book of Maccabees shows it: “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. Out of Macedon came Philip, and his son Alexander was the one who united those Europeans, all the Edomite nations, together.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”. That is what Daniel meant by bearing rule over all the earth. “whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.” This is the beginning of white supremacy in the earth, the beginning of white power: they destroyed the dark nations, and the nations and kings “became tributaries unto him.” Everybody had to pay Alexander and the Greeks tribute.

“And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.” He got sick because of syphilis. He “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and after twelve years he died. There were other generals, but the four mightiest were Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Seleucus and Cassander, and they slaughtered the others, like Antigonus, and took his land. Ptolemy took Egypt, Seleucus had Syria, Cassander had Macedonia, and Lysimachus had Thrace and Asia Minor. That is how the empire was divided. “And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

Who was Alexander? The Chronology of Ancient Nations (1879) gives the pedigree of Philip, with Greek and Roman gods inserted to make them seem more important, running back through Eliphaz to Esau, Isaac and Abraham. The Rise of Christendom (1890) says King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac. The scholars in the know know that Alexander was an Edomite; it is just our people who don't have a clue.

So the brass kingdom of the image is Esau ruling over all the earth, and it runs on into the iron of Rome and the feet of iron and clay, America and NATO, the last empire, still a continuation of Rome. The party isn't over, until the stone strikes the feet.

precepts.label: Ephesians 2:20
precepts.why:
Daniel saw “that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold”. Inquiring minds want to know who this stone is, and Paul answers: “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. The chief cornerstone is the leader; that means he is the King. The stone is Christ.

“without hands” means without man's hands. “the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.” Christ is coming to destroy these empires.

And where does the stone hit? It “smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.” That is Edom's Achilles heel. It is the promise from the beginning: “it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.” The feet are the last empire, America and NATO from 1776 until today. When the stone strikes there, “the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold” are broken to pieces together and become “like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them”.

“and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.” That great mountain is God's kingdom being established, the kingdom that “shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people”. Other races will be there, but they won't be ruling a thing. We are living in the days of these kings, and what you see here is the beginning of God's kingdom. You might kill millions of us, but this truth is going to continue, because the King it is built on is the chief corner stone.

thread.text: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

classes.title: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.label: Luke 11:17
precepts.why:
The fourth kingdom “shall be strong as iron” is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. But Daniel goes on: in the feet and toes, “part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”. They have that same military strength Rome had, yet “the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Why broken? Because they are divided. That is what you see taking place right now: America is divided.

Christ said it: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” A lot of times we use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, and it is. But it is also speaking of the last days, of the kingdom that is set up in the last days, and it tells us what happens before its destruction.

Read on: “If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Which kingdom is Satan's kingdom? Europe and America. America and Europe are divided; that alliance is falling apart. Here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, and that is a sign that they are about to fall. How can his kingdom stand? It can't.

The same division is prophesied of Egypt, and America is spiritually called Egypt: “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” White people will be fighting white people, city against city, the same way the South fought against the North in the Civil War. The Lord is behind all of it.

So the iron kingdom of Daniel 2:40 is strong, but its own division is what brings it to desolation. The civil war things are already going on, even in the drawing of new districts between Texas and California to hold the House and the Senate. Pay attention: a house divided against a house falls.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee”. This is a law. Any man we set over us, God has to choose him, and he has to be one from among our people, an Israelite.

Set that beside Daniel 4:17. “the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.” The people ruling right now are the basest of men, the bottom of the bottom line. They are not chosen from among our brethren; God put them in position to check us, because some of our people were evil as hell.

Yet our people take the base men and women set up in this time for their leaders. Officer Tatum speaks of people that he loves and respects, people chosen by God, and he is not talking about black people; he is talking about the so-called Jews, Amalek, while they kill Palestinians and children by the tens of thousands, the same people who killed Martin Luther King, Malcolm X and the African leaders. That is the house negro who runs and tells the master what you are about to do, white people in black skin, and there are hundreds of thousands, maybe millions, with that mindset. They will come against us in these last days to put the prophets to death.

Nicki Minaj, with millions of followers, speaks of our president on the stage of Turning Point USA. Some of your daughters look at these hoes like role models and spokespersons for the black community, but who put these hoes as leaders? These negroes forgot they did not come here voluntarily; they forgot the slave ships, the shackles, and the millions of forefathers who died. She is rebranding herself as a faithful Christian by going with the Republicans, but Republican or Democrat, it is the same beast.

Stop thinking you have a magic scripture for some of these negroes; some are our fathers, mothers, brothers and children, and their fate is sealed. They can only repent or die. The king over Israel must be one God chooses from among our brethren; everything else set over us now is the basest of men, and it is only for a time.

precepts.label: Daniel 3:1-6
precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar is the head of gold in Daniel's dream, and before God humbled him in chapter 4, his pride is shown in chapter 3: “Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.” In his pride he set up a golden image and said everybody should worship it.

He gathered the princes, the governors, the captains, the judges and all the rulers of the provinces to its dedication, and “an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages”, that when they heard the music they should “fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up”. And “whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.”

That is the same thing America does now with the flag. You don't bow down to it; now you have to stand up and salute it and honor it. It is the same as it was in ancient Babylon, just a different way.

This is why the decree of Daniel 4 came upon him. Nebuchadnezzar got prideful, and pride brings a man low. Twelve months after Daniel's interpretation he said, “Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?” God calls America Babylon the great, and Nebuchadnezzar called Babylon great himself. “While the word was in the king’s mouth”, the kingdom departed from him. You try to make people worship you, and it is taken.

He was made to eat grass as oxen “until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. Until you humble yourself, you are eating grass. And he did humble himself; he came back and confessed there is no God like the God of Daniel. All kingdoms fall because of pride, Assyria, Babylon, the Greeks, Rome and America, and nobody is exempt from God's judgment for it.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:14
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. The bear is Persia and Media, a dual empire, and it raised itself up on one side because Persia rose up greater than the Medes. To explain the three ribs, go to Isaiah 45.

It opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”. God chose Cyrus the Persian to release the Israelites. And what did Persia receive? “The labour of Egypt”: that is one rib. “and merchandise of Ethiopia”: that is the second. “and of the Sabeans”: that is Somalia, the third. “men of stature”, tall men, “shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee”.

So when the Most High told Cyrus to release his people from captivity, he promised to make him ruler over many nations, and these three are the ribs between the bear's teeth. “and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh”: that means conquer. The Scripture explains the Scripture; the ribs are not a mystery once you lay the precept beside the vision.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 12:10-11
precepts.why:
Daniel gives an animal for each of the first three kingdoms: the lion for Babylon, the bear for Persia and Media, the leopard for the Greeks. But for the fourth beast, “dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”, with “great iron teeth”, no animal is named. You have to go to 2 Esdras 12.

“This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” The animal symbol Daniel was not shown is the eagle, and it was only revealed to Esdras. That is why it is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little. If you don't read the Bible that way, you are going to be confused.

So the fourth beast is Rome, the eagle. It “devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it”: when you stomp on somebody so hard you can see the bootprint on his face. What did they stamp on us? Their philosophies and their doctrines. That is why we wholeheartedly believe Sunday and their days of the week, and all the foolishness the white man has told us. Its ten horns are the same ten horns of Revelation, what we call NATO today.

Esau knows the fourth one is the eagle. That is why the pictures they put out get the first three right and make up some creature for the last, to throw off the so-called black Christians, who sit in the churches saying nobody knows who the fourth kingdom is. The precept in Esdras settles it.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:25
precepts.why:
The little horn that came up among the ten is America, which came out of Britain, and it had “a mouth speaking great things.” Verse 25 is still speaking of this same beast and shows what that mouth does: “And he shall speak great words against the most High”. They blasphemed the Lord. They said, if there is a God, he is a white man.

“and shall wear out the saints of the most High”: they wore us out in slavery.

“and think to change times and laws”. Changing times is daylight saving time, and a year that begins in the dead of winter. Changing laws is same-sex laws, you can marry, if it feels good, do it; and the Sabbath moved from the seventh day to the first day of the week. They changed the laws of God.

“and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” The Israelites are given into this man's hands. A time is one, times is two, and the dividing of time makes three and a half.

And the fight against this beast is not a physical one: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” The rulers of the darkness are their governments, with America at the top of the pinnacle, followed by Britain, France and Germany. That is why we don't say Trump is the last one; when he goes, somebody else takes his seat and that spirit jumps on him. There are people behind the scenes, the deep state, the CIA, the FBI and the military officials, telling the president what to do. Republicans and Democrats are two horns on the same beast; it is good cop, bad cop, and the agenda is the same.

thread.label: Daniel 7:18
thread.text: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

precepts.label: Isaiah 32:1
precepts.why:
“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” The saints of the Most High, that is us. We are not going to ask anybody for the kingdom. We are not going to ask permission or say, can I have this. We are going to take it, and possess it for ever and ever.

Isaiah shows how we will rule it: “Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.” The kingdom the saints take will be ruled in righteousness and judgment, not like the nations that rule us now, weakening nations and taking fields by violence.

That is the whole point of it: when the saints possess the kingdom, the king reigns in righteousness and his princes, the saints with him, rule in judgment, for ever.

precepts.label: Psalms 2:10
precepts.why:
“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom.” Who are the kings that will rule it? David speaks to them: “Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.”

We are the kings, and we are to be wise. We are the judges of the earth, brothers. Believe it or not, we are the judges. Right now we look like a bunch of nobodies, but the scripture says the earth was created for us, so we are the judges of the earth.

Read on: “Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.” That is how the kings and judges prepare to take the kingdom: by being wise and instructed now, serving the Lord with fear and rejoicing with trembling.

Isaiah shows the Lord restoring those judges little by little: “And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.” We have been whittled down, but we are waking up. Those are the judges, and the Most High is restoring us back again.

precepts.label: Isaiah 9:6
precepts.why:
The saints will “possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” Whose kingdom is it? Isaiah says: “For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder.” That is Christ. His name is called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

Read on: “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end.” It is Christ's government, and there shall be no end to it. That is why the saints take the kingdom for ever.

It is “upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.” Christ orders the kingdom and establishes it with judgment and justice, and the saints possess it with him.

That is the answer to the city that became an harlot. Isaiah says it was once “full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.” There was a time we were righteous; now we kill each other like it is nothing, and every one loveth gifts. But the Lord will purge away our dross and restore us, and under Christ's government the saints will rule for ever.

thread.label: Daniel 7:23-25
thread.text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

thread.label: Daniel 7:25
thread.text: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of t

precepts.label: Exodus 12:2
precepts.why:
The “he” of Daniel 7:25 is the fourth kingdom Daniel did not understand, which the angel revealed to Ezra as the eagle with three heads: Rome, America and Britain. Daniel says “he shall speak great words against the most High”, blasphemies, “and shall wear out the saints of the most High”. Like a pair of sneakers worn so long you cannot tell what brand they were, slavery wore us out until nobody recognizes us as the Israelites, the glorious and mighty sons and daughters of God. People go, those are some damn black Africans. Now you look at a negro Latino and you go, I don't know what the hell that is. That thing, a negro, was made up, and nobody can identify them people as a race.

Then the part about time: he shall “think to change times and laws”. To see what he changed, go to what God set. “This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.”

God himself appointed the first month of the year for Israel, at the time he brought them out of Egypt. The new year is not a date man picks. It is an ordinance of God, and it is one of the times the fourth beast thought to change.

precepts.label: Exodus 13:4
precepts.why:
Which month did God make the beginning of months? “This day came ye out in the month Abib.” Abib is the name of the first month of the ancient Hebrew calendar, generally corresponding to parts of March and April in the modern Gregorian calendar: the end of March into the beginning of April, the spring season.

The word comes from Hebrew and literally means ear of grain, young green ears, sprouting. It refers to the stage when barley is ripe but still soft, marking the start of the spring harvest. God's new year begins in spring, when the barley comes in.

So when you see Israelites celebrating Passover in the winter, they don't know what the hell they are talking about. The new year was changed from spring to the dead of winter. That is what God warns us about in Daniel 7:25: he shall “think to change times and laws”.

precepts.label: John 11:9
precepts.why:
“Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.” Christ says there are twelve hours in the day.

What the white man has done is make something called daylight saving time, where they move time forward or backward. They play with times. Daniel said this man would “think to change times and laws”, and here is one more way he has done it: even the hours of the day are shifted at his word.

God set the day by his light; man changes the clock. That is one of the times the fourth kingdom has changed on the whole world.

precepts.label: Genesis 1:14-16
precepts.why:
“And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years”. The lights in the heavens were set by God to mark the times.

“And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.” The greater light is the sun, and the lesser light is the moon. When Adam and Eve were created, the moon was what they call the full moon; that was the beginning. God made two great lights. It does not say the moon was dark with only a little bit of light.

What did the white man do? He said, count from when the moon is black, or, as some say, from when it has that one sliver of light. That is not biblical. In the Bible the moon was made full. It confuses a lot of people, and there are Israelites who base holy days on when you cannot see the moon. We did that at one time too, so we are not hating; we are enlightening.

These lights are also how God swears to keep Israel. Jeremiah 31 speaks of the Lord “which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night”, and says, “If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.” Nobody can get rid of the sun, the moon or the stars, so Israel remains his people.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:12
precepts.why:
“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.” The first beast was Rome. You may think nobody worships Rome today. Really?

Look at the days of the week. Sunday is the sun, Monday the moon, Tuesday Mars, Wednesday Mercury, Thursday Jupiter, Friday Venus and Saturday Saturn. Now the months: January is named after the Roman god Janus, with two faces looking to the future and the past. February comes from Februalia, a Roman festival of purification and atonement. March is Mars, the Roman god of war. April comes from aperire, to open, like flowers in spring. May is the goddess Maia, June is the goddess Juno. July was Quintilis, the fifth month, until Julius Caesar named it after his family, and August was Sextilis until the emperor Augustus named it after himself. September, October, November and December come from the Latin for seven, eight, nine and ten, so December still says it is the tenth month while it is counted as the twelfth.

Our lives run on Roman time. That is the whole earth worshiping the first beast, and it is how he changed times. He changed laws too, like the Sabbath: the Bible says the Sabbath is the seventh day of the week, and he says the first.

Daniel goes on: “and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” Time is one, times is two, and the dividing is a half: three and a half. Revelation 11:11 says “after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them”; Revelation 12:6 counts “a thousand two hundred and threescore days”, which is 1,260 divided by 360, three and a half; and in Revelation 12:14 the woman “is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” We are nourished by America: our food, drink, clothes and education all come from the one John calls the serpent and Moses calls the enemy: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”.

Yet God has not cast away his people. “Hath God cast away his people? God forbid.” The new covenant is with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. As long as the sun, the moon and the stars remain, God will not cast away the seed of Jacob; “I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.”

precepts.label: Revelation 12:12
precepts.why:
“And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” The latter time is this time we are in now. Understanding dark sentences: there are groups among them who know who the twelve tribes are, and they know what is going to happen. Revelation 12:12 gives the example.

“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are the sovereign countries, the sovereign nations: America, the free world, and France, Germany and Britain. Those that dwell in them are their people. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth”: that is the other nations. “and of the sea”: the islands, like Jamaica and Haiti. “for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.”

How does he know his time is short? He is examining the scriptures and examining the twelve tribes of Israel, their level of engagement and understanding. They base their time on us. The churches are not bringing out the transgressions of this system; church makes you think things are paradise. We are the ones bringing out the transgressions, so we are the ones measuring when the transgressors are come to the full, and they have their eyes here. That is why YouTube, after shutting down every Israelite video for a year, let the Israelites back on: without us they were running blind in the dark.

And he comes down with great wrath. You see what Israel is doing to the Palestinians, and what America under Trump has ICE doing. It is going to get worse; the party isn't over. You can play games all you want, but the rest of us, prepare yourselves.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:2
precepts.why:
Daniel says of the king of fierce countenance, “his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”. Whose power is it? John shows it: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”. He has elements of the Greeks, elements of Persia and Media, and elements of ancient Babylon. “and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

That dragon is Satan. This man doesn't work on his own; he is dealing with spirits. China made firecrackers, and a spirit said to Esau, put a whole bunch of them together and you can make a bomb. A spirit told him to put that gunpowder in a metal casing, strike it with a spark, and shoot a piece of metal at his enemies at a distance. A spirit showed him how to build a propulsion unit to go to the moon, and a suit to breathe up there, without his ever having been there. People ask, how did the white man figure all this stuff out? Satan. The dragon gave him his power.

So “he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” The holy people are us. You are seeing an inkling of it now, but it is only going to escalate; they have not finished with the twelve tribes yet. His might is borrowed from Satan, and that is why, when the Prince of princes stands against him, “he shall be broken without hand.”

precepts.label: 1 Thessalonians 5:3
precepts.why:
“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many”. His policy is his politics. And Trump now has what is called the Board of Peace, and it charges nations a billion dollars for a permanent seat. It was first pitched to oversee the rebuilding of Gaza after the Israel and Hamas war; now its charter reaches to conflicts the world over and does not even mention Gaza, and it is set up as an alternative to the United Nations. Now you know why he didn't stop Netanyahu from bombing them.

Its founding members include Jared Kushner, Amalek, and Marco Rubio, supporting Amalek, and Tony Blair. When Amalek was killing the Palestinians in Gaza, there was a lot of complaint against them in the UN. With this, when they start killing people and taking land, you have nowhere to run to complain, because they run it. Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the African countries that sit on it will have no power. And the UN itself only has power over dark nations; Europe doesn't listen to it, and its building sits on stolen land while the Native American Indians have no seat in it at all.

Trump is not the one doing this; he is a figurehead to divert your attention. The shadow government, the powers behind him, are running it. If Trump weren't there, it would still be going on.

Paul says, “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Peace and safety is that Board of Peace. By peace he shall destroy many, but “he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”, that is Christ, “but he shall be broken without hand.” It is the same stone of Daniel 2: this last empire, the extension of ancient Rome, is going to fall. The great stone shall smash the heel, for Esau is the end of the world.

thread.label: Daniel 8:23-25
thread.text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

precepts.label: Revelation 12:3
precepts.why:
“in the latter time of their kingdom” means the last days, and “their kingdom” is the Edomite kingdoms. Verse 21 speaks of Grecia, and the Greeks were the Edomites at first: yes, they were Japheth, but Alexander and his father Philip were Edomites, and they took over everything.

John saw the same kingdoms: “behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.” Why red? Because of Esau: “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” This red dragon represents the nation, the kingdoms, of Esau.

That is the power behind the king of fierce countenance. “his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the dragon, Satan, gives them their power, and the dragon is painted red because it is ruling through Esau's kingdoms. A king of fierce countenance “understanding dark sentences” goes into religion, into the Bible; what stands up in the last days is a religious system, and it is the kingdom of the red dragon.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:1-2
precepts.why:
John “saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” It is the same beast as the red dragon. The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland.

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon, which is Satan, gave him his power. That is Daniel's king whose “power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”.

A lot of people think the white man was just so smart that he figured things out on his own. No, there are spirits he works with. Candace Owens did a video on how NASA got to the moon, with a lot of satanic worship and child sacrifice, and people said it was conspiracy; she had proof. The father of rocket science, Jack Parsons, was part of the occult religion called Thelema, with Aleister Crowley, and NASA was heavily rooted in people who joined that occult. When he joined it, his understanding was heightened and he figured out rocket fuel and how it could propel into space. The series Strange Angel tells how he basically encountered the devil and figured out rocket science. That is how they got into space: the dragon gave him his power.

So Daniel's king “shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise”, and “by peace shall destroy many”. Today Trump has the Board of Peace, and everybody says how great it is; no, they are destroying nations. But he stands up against the Prince of princes, Christ, and he “shall be broken without hand”: Christ is going to destroy him.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:6
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.” This leopard represents the Greeks. The four wings of a fowl are four major militaries. The four heads are the four major generals: Ptolemy took over Egypt, Seleucus Syria, Lysimachus Thrace, and Cassander Macedonia.

That is why Daniel 8:23 says “in the latter time of their kingdom”: it is the kingdom of Grecia carried on into the last days. When Revelation 13:2 says the beast was “like unto a leopard”, it is like the Greek Empire. It is not the actual Greek Empire, but it has elements of it.

The rest of the beast is read the same way from Daniel 7: “his feet were as the feet of a bear” is the Persians and Medes, whose symbol that was, and “his mouth as the mouth of a lion” is Babylon. So the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time carries the marks of all these kingdoms, with the dragon's power behind him.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:2
precepts.why:
Daniel says of the king of fierce countenance, “his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”. Revelation 13:2 shows whose power it is: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”. In Daniel 7 the leopard was the Greek symbol, so this last empire has attributes of ancient Greece. “and his feet were as the feet of a bear”: the bear was Persia and Media, so this last kingdom has elements of ancient Persia and Media. “and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: the lion was Babylon, so this kingdom has attributes of ancient Babylon.

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” That is the part that answers Daniel: Satan gave this man power to reign and to rule, and great authority. Who is that? The white man, starting with the United States of America, followed by Britain, France, Germany, Russia, all these empires today. Satan gave him the insight, just like Balaam, who saw in visions all the way to the last days.

What does a sinner do with power? “For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.” Water, fire, iron, salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, the blood of the grape, oil and clothing: “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” They monopolize water and bottle it and make you buy it. They take fire and make a bomb with nuclear fire. They take iron and the gunpowder found in China and make bullets and guns to kill people. They strip the salt white, they do something to the milk, they make liquors from the blood of the grape to get us drunk, and they mix the fabric of our clothing. Everything good, the sinful man, the white man, turns to evil.

So “he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” We are the mighty and holy people, and we have already been destroyed: look at every corner, every strip club, every other prison, and you will see our people there. His might is Satan's, and that is why he will not be broken by a man's hand: “he shall be broken without hand.” God is going to break this man with his power.

precepts.why:
Daniel says “the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god”. Paul says of the man of sin, “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. This is the same wording as Daniel; they are talking about the same thing. He magnifies himself against Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, whatever it is. He magnifies himself as God, and that is the white Jesus.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: he says his churches are the churches of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: that is this white man. What we read in Thessalonians is identifying the false prophet in the last days, and it is the same king who in Daniel honours “a god whom his fathers knew not” and does his work “with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”. The strange god is the white Jesus.

How was that strange god made? “For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.” “For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god”. It happened with Nimrod, Osiris, Julius Caesar, Alexander and Hercules, all worshipped as gods after their deaths. And it happened with Pope Alexander VI and his son Caesar Borgia: the father died before the son, but it was the father's instruction to use his son as white Jesus. It is an open secret that Caesar Borgia posed for the bust of the Saviour.

“Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.” The custom of worshipping the white man as Jesus grew strong in the earth; there are images of Caesar as Jesus in Brazil, New York, Mexico, you name it. “For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Christianity is an idolatrous religion.

John saw the same beast: “he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God”. The white man set himself up as God and went against all God's laws; that is the function of the Roman Catholic Church. “it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: Spain and Portugal made war against the saints of God and overcame us in slavery. “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”. That is the man who exalts himself above all that is called God.

precepts.label: Psalms 91:1-12
precepts.why:
Daniel says “there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered”. What makes this tribulation different is World War III and Armageddon, and Psalm 91 shows how Israel is delivered in the midst of it.

“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible.

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day; Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” The arrow that flieth by day is the missile, the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” And “he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.”

That is the deliverance of the Israelites in the midst of Armageddon: thy people delivered, every one found written in the book, not all nations. It is the same psalm Satan twisted when he told Christ to jump from the pinnacle of the temple.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:37-45
precepts.why:
Daniel's “time of trouble, such as never was” is World War III and Armageddon. Ezra shows it: “And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.”

“And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west. And strong winds shall arise from the east”: storms from all four winds.

They “shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star, Fire, and hail, and flying swords”. The horrible star is the ICBM, and the flying swords are the missiles. “And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.”

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. And “then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her”, just as Revelation 18 says the kings and merchants of the earth will bewail her. That is the time of trouble in which Daniel's people, every one written in the book, shall be delivered.

precepts.label: Luke 4:9-12
precepts.why:
Psalm 91 promises the deliverance of Israel in the time of trouble: “He shall give his angels charge over thee”. Satan used that same psalm on Christ: “And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence”.

“For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.” Satan twisted the psalm into a dare, telling Christ to jump.

“And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.” Christ answered that way because the psalm is not a dare to test God. It is about the deliverance of Israel in the midst of Armageddon, when a thousand fall at our side and ten thousand at our right hand, and the angels bear us up.

precepts.label: Revelation 11:11-13
precepts.why:
Daniel says “at that time thy people shall be delivered”. John shows the order of it: “And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.” That standing up is now.

“And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.” Between the standing up and the deliverance, John left out the tribulation, World War III and Armageddon; the precepts supply it. Tribulation has to come, then World War III, then Armageddon, when Christ comes in the midst of World War III.

“And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.” A great destruction.

The Israelites who want to invest in airplanes and boats to get out do not believe the angels are coming. Come up hither is the deliverance: the angels bear us up, as Psalm 91 says.

That is why we are destroyed as a race, as a people, mentally and spiritually. The twelve tribes of Israel are a destroyed race. The black man and the brown man do have the ability, and many of us have the knowledge to do it, but they do not want us to have the capabilities.

thread.label: Amos 6:1-8
thread.text: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

classes.title: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

precepts.label: 1 Kings 8:1
precepts.why:
“Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria”. At ease in Zion: that is the southern kingdom. Trust in the mountain of Samaria: that is the northern kingdom. How do we know Zion is Judah’s Jerusalem?

“Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.” The city of David, which is Zion. So Jerusalem was also called Zion.

So Amos is speaking a woe to both houses at once: Judah at ease in Zion, and the northern kingdom trusting in Samaria. And he tells them both what is coming: “I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.” All twelve tribes were going off, so the southern kingdom was going to get it, and the northern kingdom too.

precepts.label: John 4:20-24
precepts.why:
Amos set Zion and the mountain of Samaria against each other, and Christ speaks to the same divide with the Samaritan woman. “Our fathers worshipped in this mountain”: that was Mount Gerizim. “and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship”: y’all Jews say that.

“Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.” Why? Because 70 AD was coming; Rome was going to destroy all the remaining Israelites.

“Ye worship ye know not what”: you, northern kingdom, don’t understand what you are worshipping, because the northern kingdom went into idolatry. “we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.” Salvation comes from Judah.

What was he letting her know? The temple was going to be destroyed, the Israelites would go into captivity, and you would have to deal with the Lord one on one, with no more priests intervening for you: “the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth”. Neither Samaria’s mountain nor Zion would stand; both houses would go captive, as Amos said.

precepts.label: Psalms 76:1
precepts.why:
“In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.” Christ told the Samaritan woman “salvation is of the Jews”, and the psalm agrees: in Judah is God known.

That is why Christ came out of Judah. Salvation comes from Judah. He is not tribe hopping.

So when Amos speaks against those at ease in Zion and those who trust in the mountain of Samaria, the difference between the two is not that one of them was righteous; all twelve went off and both would go captive. But God was known in Judah, and out of Judah the salvation of all Israel would come.
