Daniel shows it: “Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.”

That is determined upon Daniel's people and holy city, and the most Holy anointed is Christ. Through Christ we get our reconciliation. So the very masters who twisted Colossians 3:22 wrote down, in their own directions, that their slaves were the people God reconciles: Israel.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
The third direction to the masters: serve your necessities by your slaves so as to prefer God's interest and their spiritual and everlasting happiness; teach them the way to heaven. So in want of all things we wanted food, clothing, housing, shelter, and we also got that old time religion from them too.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. In want of all things: even our religion had to come from the enemy we were serving.

The next page shows what that religion was for. They wrote that we were redeemed with them by Christ from the slavery of Satan and may live with them in the liberty of the saints in glory. They want us to go to heaven with them and live with them. That's called hell. That mind was beaten into us: a brother on the street asked if the Edomite could be saved, and said if he goes to hell, so will I, because he doesn't want to go anywhere without his master. That is the want of all things the curse brought, and why the master's reading of Colossians 3:22 still holds our people.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 5:19
precepts.why:
The masters' own book says of us: they are in the eye of the law property. In the eyes of their laws, we were their property. The Lord told us why: “And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.”

We are serving strangers in a land that is not ours, a land we are not familiar with. That is the servitude the Lord allowed because we forsook him.

So the slavery here was the curse on Israel for serving strange gods, not the obedience Colossians 3:22 teaches between Israelite servants and Israelite masters. They took the scripture and used it to hold us as property, but the Lord had already told us we would serve strangers.

precepts.label: Lamentations 5:8
precepts.why:
Jeremiah said we would serve strangers in a land that is not ours. The Lamentations goes further: “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” Servants have ruled over us. This is Bible prophecy.

It happened in the time of Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America in the present day. It keeps happening over and over again. Why? Because we are the people of God. But this is the last time.

So the masters who took Colossians 3:22 and told us “Servants, obey in all things your masters” were themselves the servants ruling over Israel, just as the prophets lamented, with none to deliver us out of their hand.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 5:42
precepts.why:
Servants ruling over us happened with Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America present day. The Lord explains it to Ezra: “And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring”.

A ring is a circular motion. You see this curse? It comes right back around, empire after empire, and it keeps happening because we are the people of God. But this is the last time. All praise to the Most High.

So the slavery in America where Colossians 3:22 was used against us is one more turn of that ring of judgment on Israel. It was not the Lord making the white man our rightful master; it was his judgment coming back around on his own people, and it ends with this last time.

precepts.label: Nehemiah 9:37

We were their property, and they still view us as that. They may have said we were equal in salvation, but while we were here they treated us like beasts: chattel slavery, three-fifths of a man. They never looked at us as their equals.

Nehemiah prayed it: “And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins”. This is happening because we sinned against our God. “also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.” Dominion over our bodies, to look at us as their property, at their pleasure.

Their own book says it plainly: they are in the eye of the law property over which there is an absolute control; and by law or custom we were excluded from education, and by consequence from the reading of the word of God. If we were equal, why were we excluded from education? Because they don't want us to know the truth of the Bible, that servants obey your masters isn't talking about them. They want to keep us docile and uneducated.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:14-15

Their book says we may, according to the power lodged in our hands, forbid religious meetings, and no independent churches were allowed, so we depended on them alone. It went on during the Inquisition too, when they changed Christianity into the all-inclusive Catholic system and went around killing us, the real Jews, tearing up our safe houses and taking our book. precepts.label: Isaiah 32:7

thread.label: Colossians 4:1
thread.text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 19:21
precepts.why:
Colossians 3:22, read in context, says “Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God”. Why? Your master was taking care of your clothes, your raiment, your housing, your food. So why would you disrespect him? Number one, that is your brother. Number two, he is doing this for you: as you do your duties and work, he takes care of you.

Sirach says it: “If a servant say to his master, I will not do as it pleaseth thee; though afterward he do it, he angereth him that nourisheth him.” The master nourishes the servant, and a servant who refuses him angers the one that feeds him.

And you are not just angering the master. You are also angering the Lord that nourisheth us. That is the order Colossians 4:1 completes from the other side: the servant honours the master, and the master gives the servant “that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.”

precepts.label: Ephesians 6:5-6
precepts.why:
“Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal”. They said that they were the masters. Did they do that? No. They were living in the big house; we were living in the outhouse, and when we got emancipated, did they ever give us the forty acres and the mule? No. So they are showing that they are hypocrites. They are impostors. They’re the damn devil that the Bible speaks of.

Remember, Colossians, Ephesians and Philemon were all written generally at the same time, to the same region. Ephesians says the same thing Colossians does: “Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ; Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart”.

The servants are serving “as unto Christ”, as “the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart.” This is instruction to one people serving under Christ, not a charter for the slave masters of America, and the verse ends by reminding the masters they “also have a Master in heaven.”

precepts.label: Jeremiah 34:9
precepts.why:
To go a little deeper into who these servants are, Jeremiah says: “That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.”

Being a what? An Hebrew, or an Hebrewess. So these servants are Israelites. And the one they served was “a Jew his brother.”

That is the servant and master of Colossians 3:22 and 4:1: Israelite servants and Israelite masters, brothers. Christianity took a scripture about brethren and cherry-picked it to fit its evil narrative over us.

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 6:1-2
precepts.why:
Paul elaborates on the masters: “Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.” The servants are under the yoke, the yoke of bondage. If you had a master who still believed in the law of sacrifice, but you believed on Christ, you still honoured him. He follows sacrifice, but you still treat him with respect.

“And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren”. Now you have Israelite masters who believe on Christ. Don’t despise a master, your brother, that believes on Christ, because they are brethren.

Not one time has the Lord ever said we are brothers with the other nations. So that is showing you those masters are Israelites. When Colossians 4:1 tells masters to give their servants what is just and equal, it is speaking to Israelite masters over Israelite servants, their brethren.

precepts.label: Galatians 3:28
precepts.why:
Now this makes more sense: “There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.”

Neither Jew nor Greek we already understand from Colossians 3:11: the Greek-speaking Jews and the Jews. Neither bond nor free: the Israelite servant and the Israelite master. Neither male nor female: the manservant and the maidservant, the Israelite man and the Israelite woman.

“for ye are all one”: we are all one nation, under Christ. That is all it is talking about. So the servants and masters of Colossians 4:1 are one people in Christ, and that is why the master must give the servant what is just and equal.

precepts.label: Leviticus 25:55
precepts.why:
More on these servants: “For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.”

The children of Israel are servants, and they are his servants, the ones he brought out of Egypt. That is who the servants of Colossians are, and why the masters must remember they “also have a Master in heaven”: the servants belong to the Lord.

They changed the narrative and flipped the script, inserting themselves into the scriptures where they are not. Where they are, Leviticus shows it right after: “Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you”, and “they shall be your bondmen for ever”. They were originally our possession, but we sinned against our God and became their possession. Don’t worry: it is going to go back to the way it is supposed to be.

precepts.label: Romans 14:4
precepts.why:
When we read precept upon precept, in the context of the scriptures, we see how we have been lied to as a people. Paul asks: “Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth.”

Who are you to judge another man’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. So our real master is Christ. That is the “Master in heaven” of Colossians 4:1, the one both servants and masters answer to.

And the servant is not left alone: “Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.” There it is. For God is able to make him stand.

Paul beseeches the brethren “by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him.” That “him” is Christ, and Genesis 49:10 shows why: “unto him shall the gathering of the people be.” He is the only one who can gather all twelve tribes together. When people on earth say they are the ones Christ is using to gather the twelve tribes, don't listen to that.

Jacob's blessing lays it out. “The sceptre shall not depart from Judah”: the sceptre is the kingship. “nor a lawgiver from between his feet”: between the feet means the loins, the seed. The lawgiver comes out of Judah's loins, which shows there is no immaculate conception. “until Shiloh come”: until Christ comes.

That is why Paul tells them “be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled.” In his time many were running around saying the resurrection had come and gone already. Paul reminds them not to let anyone deceive them; Christ had not returned, and the gathering belongs to him alone, when he comes.

precepts.label: Luke 21:24
precepts.why:
Paul says “that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.” The falling away is not people leaving Christianity to join Islam, the way Christians read it. The falling away means the twelve tribes of Israel have to fall and go into captivity, and Luke 21:24 shows it.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: the Israelites. “and shall be led away captive into all nations”: slavery. “and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”: Jerusalem taken over by other nations, in particular the Edomite nations, “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”, until that time of rulership is over.

So two things have to happen before Christ returns: all twelve tribes must go into captivity, which is where we are now, and the man of sin must be revealed, the son of perdition. Perdition means eternal damnation, spiritual ruin and hell; it comes from the Latin perdere, to destroy or to lose. It is the fate of the wicked, the absolute loss of one's soul, the final loss of salvation and unending punishment.

precepts.label: Luke 21:24
precepts.why:
“for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” What is the falling away? Slavery, captivity. And the precept for it is Luke: “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.”

We fell by the edge of the sword, and we were led away as slaves into all nations. That is what happened to us. Before Christ returns, Israel had to fall away, and that falling away goes into a lot: it goes into us even forgetting our nationality and all of that.

The apostles asked Christ what they had to look for before his return and for the end, and Paul is explaining the same thing here. “Let no man deceive you by any means” is the same thing Christ said: don’t let anybody deceive you. All the prophets say the same thing in different words. Christ said Israel would be led captive until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled; Paul says the day of the Lord shall not come except there come a falling away first.

And while Israel is in that captivity, “that man of sin” must “be revealed, the son of perdition.” Instead of saying antichrist, Paul says the man of sin. It is not one person but a race, a people: Edom, the one Malachi says the prophets “shall call them, The border of wickedness.” That is the time we are living in now, with Israel fallen away into all nations and the prophets revealing the wicked, and that is why the day of the Lord has not yet come.

precepts.why:
We go to Revelation because of “the mystery of iniquity.” Upon the woman’s forehead was a name written: “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” The mystery of iniquity that “doth already work” is this Mystery, Babylon the Great: the nation, the kingdom of perdition. thread.text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

precepts.label: Isaiah 13:2-3
precepts.why:
“And then shall that Wicked be revealed.” The wicked is not going to be revealed on his own; the prophets must reveal him. People think he will be revealed through osmosis, or that Professor X is going to use his telepathy and tell everybody on the planet the white man is the devil. That is not going to happen. There is no Professor X. Isaiah shows how God reveals him.

“Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”: the banner is the Bible. “exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand”: reprove them, correct them. “that they may go into the gates of the nobles”: that they may go to the Edomites. It is not black people; the nobles is white folks.

“I have commanded my sanctified ones”: that is us, the ones lifting up the banner and exalting the voice. “I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness”: the mighty ones are the angels. So the wicked is revealed by God’s sanctified ones preaching the word, and then the Lord consumes him “with the spirit of his mouth” and destroys him “with the brightness of his coming.”

thread.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:8-9
thread.text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

precepts.label: Jeremiah 5:14
precepts.why:
Paul says the Wicked shall be revealed, “whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth.” The spirit of God's mouth is the holy Bible, and Jeremiah 5:14 shows how it consumes: “behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.”

Some of us speak very well and have eloquent words, and that is fine, but we must use God's word; that is where the power is. We read the Bible but don't see the spiritual effect it has in this realm, because our eyes are closed. God is saying, my word is fire. Speak it whether they hear or forbear. Even those who reject it are at home tossing and tumbling in their beds, because the way it is broken down haunts them.

As we teach the word of God, we are judging, and many are being marked for death. Everyone who hears it and rejects it and refuses it: remember that Christ said it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah than for those who do not hear his messengers. The words are the fire, the people who reject them are the wood, and that is how the Lord consumes the wicked with the spirit of his mouth.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:37-38
precepts.why:
The Lord shall consume that Wicked “with the spirit of his mouth”, and 2 Esdras 13 shows the Son doing it: “this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest.”

Those wicked inventions are the ICBM missiles and all that technology, their satellites spread across the globe. Christ will rebuke all of it and “shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame.”

Then: “he shall destroy them without labour by the law.” He will not need their weapons; the law does the destroying. God is saying his law is fire, the same fire that is in the mouth of those who teach it. That is the spirit of his mouth and “the brightness of his coming” that destroys the Wicked in 2 Thessalonians 2.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 23:29
precepts.why:
“Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?” This is the same power Paul describes when the Lord consumes that Wicked “with the spirit of his mouth.” God's word is the fire and the hammer.

We have to believe that. Sometimes we only believe what we can see. The Lord said the angels are all around us; we just don't see them. In the same way, we don't see the word working in the spirit, but it is working. When it is spoken it breaks the rock in pieces, whether the hearer receives it or not.

That is why we must use God's word and not our own eloquence. Those who reject it are condemned by it, and when Christ comes, that same word destroys the Wicked by the brightness of his coming.

precepts.label: Genesis 4:7
precepts.why:
Paul says the Wicked's “coming is after the working of Satan.” Our comings are supposed to be after Christ the Lord, but the white man's comings and goings are after Satan, and that goes back to Genesis 4.

The Lord speaks to Cain: “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door.” Then the speech switches. “And unto thee shall be his desire”: now he is talking to Satan. Cain's desire shall be unto Satan, “and thou shalt rule over him”: Satan shall rule over Cain.

So from the beginning Cain was put under Satan's rule, and his line has walked after Satan ever since. That is why the coming of the man of sin is “after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”: he is following the one who was set to rule over his father.

precepts.label: John 8:44
precepts.why:
Christ said this to the Pharisees, who were so in love with Rome: “Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.” The lusts are the desires; they will do whatever their father desires.

“He was a murderer from the beginning”: that is Cain, not the spiritual demon. Cain murdered Abel. “When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.” Cain is a liar and the father of lies. Why? Because Satan is his father; Satan is his daddy.

This ties to Genesis 4:7, where Satan was set to rule over Cain, and to 2 Thessalonians 2:9, the Wicked “whose coming is after the working of Satan.” The line of Cain comes and goes after Satan, murdering and lying, just as their father did.

precepts.label: Psalms 109:6
precepts.why:
“Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” That is Genesis 4:7, where Satan was set to rule over Cain, and it is 2 Thessalonians 2, the Wicked “whose coming is after the working of Satan.”

The wicked man has Satan standing at his right hand, and he follows everything Satan says. That is why his coming is with “all power and signs and lying wonders”: it is Satan's working carried out through the man he rules.

So the scriptures line up from the beginning to the end: Cain under Satan's rule, the Pharisees doing the lusts of their father the devil, and the man of sin coming after the working of Satan, until the Lord consumes him with the spirit of his mouth.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:24
precepts.why:
The Wicked comes “with all power and signs and lying wonders”, and Christ warned of the same: “there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.”

The great signs and wonders go with their science and their technology. Something major is going to happen. No one knows when, but before this kingdom goes down there is going to be a worldwide event to deceive the world, and some of us, God forbid, will be deceived by it.

That is why we must hold to God's word. The lying wonders come after the working of Satan, and only the word, the fire in our mouths, will keep us from being taken in when they come.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:13-14
precepts.why:
Revelation 13 describes the same working Paul does: “he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men.” That fire coming down from heaven is thermonuclear fire.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do.” See what it calls them: miracles. Those are the signs and wonders. It says the same thing Matthew 24 says and 2 Thessalonians 2 says, “signs and lying wonders”, only with a different word.

So the Wicked's coming after the working of Satan shows up as their science and their weapons, fire from heaven that looks like miracles, used to deceive the world. The Lord will consume him with the spirit of his mouth and destroy him with the brightness of his coming.

Who's going into what sport? We bid on you. That's what they do.

“For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.” So when you're asked to work seven days a week or work on the Sabbath, don't call us and say, hey, is it okay if I break the Sabbath? We're going to tell you no. We're not going to tell you to break God's laws; that's between you and the Lord. Don't involve us in your trial.

The love of money is the love they took in place of the love of the truth, and it drowns them in perdition.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 9:10-12
precepts.why:
“For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me”: that's the riches, the fame, the fortune. “And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty”: while the brothers were on the street preaching and teaching.

“and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it; The same must know it after death by pain.” The door of repentance was open to them, and they despised it.

That is the end of them that perish in 2 Thessalonians 2:10. They received not the love of the truth, God's law, while they had time and liberty, and the same must know it after death by pain.

thread.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:11-15
thread.text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:4
precepts.why:
God said it himself: “I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.” God chooses the delusion. That is the “strong delusion” of Thessalonians, sent “that they should believe a lie.”

Because you reject God’s laws in Christ, he said, I am going to send you a strong delusion, and you are going to believe a lie. That is why with these stupid faith healings everybody knows are fake, grandma for some reason can’t understand that they are fake: she has a strong delusion on her. The statue of Jesus crying, or the blood that came from the tree. There is no scripture you can pull to pull them out of that delusion, because God chose it for them when they would not answer his call.

It is the same with prayers for people who will not repent. A pastor was asked to pray for someone’s mother: no, your mama is wicked as hell; you think prayers will make your mama repent? You have to first have a willing spirit, and that is the key people keep missing. The worst one: my husband beat me, threw me down the stairs, took all my money, pray for him. Pray that he magically starts loving you? We are going to pray that you get therapy, or get the hell away from him. Where there is no willing spirit, the delusion stands.

precepts.label: Romans 12:10
precepts.why:
“Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another.” That is how the chosen are to walk with each other, those God “hath from the beginning chosen” to salvation “through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth.”

You know that offends white folks. We were on a quest reading scriptures among ourselves, and these white people hate that. The other nations hate that thing: our people gathered together, loving one another, preferring one another in honour.

That is what it means to “stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught.” Stand firm in his truth, and hold the traditions of God’s laws as you have been taught them, whether by word, face to face, or by the epistles. The law says be kindly affectioned one towards another, and that brotherly love among ourselves is part of holding fast to the truth while the rest of the world believes the lie.

precepts.label: Zephaniah 2:1
precepts.why:
“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” We are the nation not desired. Nobody wants to be with us; no nation wants to take us in.

So we gather together amongst ourselves, and in that gathering the law says be kindly affectioned one towards another with brotherly love. The other nations hate to see it, but God told the nation not desired to gather itself together.

These are the brethren “beloved of the Lord” whom God “hath from the beginning chosen” to salvation. Others are given a strong delusion to believe a lie because they had pleasure in unrighteousness; the chosen are called by the gospel “to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.” So, brethren, stand fast, hold the traditions you have been taught, and gather together.

precepts.label: Psalms 119:142
precepts.why:
Paul says “that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith”, and he ends by saying meats were created “to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.” What is the truth they depart from? David says: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.”

God's law is the truth, and that is what these religions would have you depart from. We are in the latter times now. Some of you men and women listening will depart from the truth of Christ: some because of persecution for the word's sake, and some because you see signs and wonders, technological signs and wonders, and believe we have been wrong all this time. It is already written, as Christ said: “there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders”, and “Behold, I have told you before.”

They give heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils, “Speaking lies in hypocrisy”: they have the Bible, but they are hypocrites. And “having their conscience seared with a hot iron”: you can't wake them up. “Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats”: that is Roman Catholicism, which forbids the men to marry and commands you to abstain from meats during Lent. The religion of the false prophet starts with Christianity.

But the law is the truth, and those who believe and know the truth receive with thanksgiving what God created, and do not depart from his everlasting righteousness.

thread.label: 1 Timothy 4:1
thread.text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

precepts.label: Psalms 119:142
precepts.why:
“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.” This is a prophecy about the world's last religion, the one they will force on us, and some of you, men and women, will give yourselves to it. We are living in the latter times.

What are the doctrines of devils? “Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; Forbidding to marry.” Here is the clue: what religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity; they forbid their priests to marry. Then “commanding to abstain from meats”: Lent, forty days with no meat. Meats “which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.”

What is the truth? David answers: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” The truth is God's laws. Those who know the law receive what God created with thanksgiving; those seduced by doctrines of devils forbid to marry and abstain from meats.

Why do people get seduced into all this crap? Because they were idle, I-D-L-E, and they were given Christianity, an idol, I-D-O-L. Christianity is an idolatrous religion. The one who holds the law, the truth, will not depart from the faith.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:10
precepts.why:
In the latter times “some shall depart from the faith.” Christ said the same in Matthew 24: “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.”

Many of you shall be offended. What are you going to do? You are going to betray the believing brothers and sisters, and you shall hate us. That is the departing from the faith Paul prophesied.

Read on: “And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” That is this Christianity. On TikTok everybody is a pastor: every man, every woman, every boy, every girl, out of nowhere. Those who depart from the faith are the ones who give heed to them, and they end up offended at the truth and betraying and hating the people who taught it to them.

precepts.label: Mark 13:22
precepts.why:
Paul says those who depart from the faith give “heed to seducing spirits.” Mark shows where that seducing spirit comes from: “For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.”

The false Christs and false prophets rise on TikTok and Instagram. These Christians under Israel's banner, the fake Israel's banner, get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. Remember in Revelation how they called fire down from heaven, and that fire from heaven was called wonders on the earth. Those are the signs and wonders.

They rise “to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.” That lets us know there will be a seducing spirit in the last days to get us back into Christianity, back into colonialism, back into that damnable slave religion called Christianity. The seducing spirit that Mark, Matthew and Paul to Timothy all address is in these days.

Revelation names the three unclean spirits like frogs: out of the mouth of the dragon, politics; out of the mouth of the beast, the United States and its financial system; “and out of the mouth of the false prophet”, religion, which is Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles”, gathering the kings of the earth to the battle of that great day. So do not tell us the Bible is not true. If you want to play games and go back into Christianity, go; there are no bars on the door.

precepts.label: 1 John 3:4
precepts.why:
Moses chose “rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season.” What is the sin he refused? John defines it: “Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.”

Sin is breaking God’s law. The pleasures of sin are the pleasures of transgressing the law, and if anybody says sin isn’t pleasurable, that’s a lie. It is very fun. But you have to perform abstinence, and choose affliction with the people of God over it, the way Moses did.

That is the difference between Moses and the hireling. A hireling has a temporary time in this truth. He or she doesn’t care about salvation, and is willing to destroy the family, the brotherhood, everything they built up, just for their own sin. The love of sin. The hireling chooses the pleasure of transgressing the law for a season; the true servant chooses to suffer with the people of God.

precepts.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:12
precepts.why:
The pleasures of sin last only “for a season”, and Paul shows where they end: “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.”

If anybody says sin isn’t pleasurable, that’s a lie; it is very fun. That is exactly why it is dangerous. Those who have pleasure in unrighteousness instead of believing the truth are the ones who are damned. So you have to perform abstinence.

Moses saw it. He chose “rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season.” The hireling does the opposite. He has a temporary time in this truth and does not care about salvation. He or she is willing to destroy the family, the brotherhood and everything they built up, just for their own sin, for the love of sin. That love of sin is having pleasure in unrighteousness, and its end is damnation.

thread.label: 2 Peter 2:18
thread.text: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 2:4
precepts.why:
Paul warned of them: “by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.” Good words and fair speeches: intellectual, big words, semantics, rhetoric. They serve theology; their theology is their god, and their own belly, money. Peter says the same: “For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh”. There are no laws involved, no commandments involved.

The commentary on Peter says it: false teachers who sound impressive yet deliver nothing of substance. Homoousios, hypostatic, exegesis, ontological, hermeneutical, Christological: great swelling words. Their speech is grand, polished, well paced, even spiritual sounding, like Bible, but it is hollow, with no commandments, no responsibility, no accountability. Unlike Paul, who said “my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power”. Paul refused persuasive words of man's wisdom; these teachers rely on style over truth, eloquence without gospel substance. In the Greek, great swelling words means great bulk: high sounding, but only words, vain and meaningless, with nothing but emptiness behind them.

Show me the scripture that says Christ is fully God and fully man. It isn't there. The word of God is plain and clear. Even their hermeneutics goes back to Schleiermacher, a German called the father of modern liberal theology, and Isaiah says “The vile person shall be no more called liberal”; the vile person will “utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry”. The word comes from Hermes, the Greek trickster god, so it is a trickster's interpretation, and the Jesuits carried it around the earth.

Peel back the swelling words and here is the premise: if Christ is fully God and fully man, only a two-essence being can keep God's laws, so we don't have to. But Christ said be perfect, as your Father in heaven is perfect, and Zacharias and Elisabeth walked “in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.” It can be done. “The discourse of fools is irksome, and their sport is the wantonness of sin”: their sport is not having to keep the commandments.

thread.label: 2 Peter 3:3-11
thread.text: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

precepts.label: Job 1:22
precepts.why:
Peter says “there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts, And saying, Where is the promise of his coming?” A scoffer mocks and ridicules; he doesn't just disagree, he expresses insolent doubt and derision, openly opposing God and divine truth, arrogant, close-minded and fueled by pride. Of all the reasons people scoff at the Bible, one stands out: the problem of evil and suffering, why God would permit harm.

An ex-pastor turned atheist, who preached in the streets and the prisons for fifteen years, now says the Bible is fiction, that black people are not Israelites, that even if we were he would hate that God, and asks what Jesus did about slavery, Jim Crow and the Trail of Tears. Going through his page, the reason showed itself: he has a child in remission from stage four brain cancer. That's a lot of trauma. Maybe they tried the holy water and the laying on of hands and nothing worked.

A lot of times when bad things happen, people turn around and blame God: God, why did you do this to me? That is why a lot of people turn atheist. One sister had a miscarriage and started blaming God. But we have to do what Job did. Job lost his children, his wealth and his health, and “In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.” He didn't charge God foolishly. That's it. We cannot charge God foolishly, knowing that he has his reasons.

And as for the cures for cancer being hidden: after the Epstein files dropped we saw how much the pharmaceutical companies were holding back. They already have patents on things and hold them back because there is more money in the treatment than the cure. The scoffer blames God for what the wicked have done, and he is willingly ignorant, like the scoffers in the days of Noah, whom God put to death.

thread.label: 2 Peter 3:8
thread.text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

precepts.label: Baruch 4:25
precepts.why:
Peter says “that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.” David says our days are seventy, eighty years. Do the math: if a thousand years is one day to God, eighty years is 0.08 of a day, about an hour and fifty-five minutes. An entire human lifetime is less than two hours to God, and it may be even less than that; the concept of time does not apply to the Ancient of days. Eighty years and you come back and God says, you just left, why you back already?

That is why the scriptures say things like Baruch: “My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee”. It is happening right now. We are going through it, and it seems like forever, because down here it takes forever to become an adult, to get your license, to turn 21. Lord, come save us; they are doing their worst.

Then, “but shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck.” Shortly: in less than a few minutes of God's time your life is over, and in an hour or so you see the destruction of your enemy and have a lifetime of God time, eternal. So suffer patiently. What seems long to us is short to him.

precepts.label: Isaiah 54:7-8
precepts.why:
“For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.” A small moment. That is why God says small moment: it is not even two hours to him, not even a day to him. If a thousand years is as one day with the Lord, our whole captivity is a moment in his eyes.

“In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.” For a moment. Start thinking like that: I'm only here for a short while.

And since it is only a moment, Peter gives the wisdom Christ put in his mouth: “Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time”. The real exaltation we want is when we go back to him: a crown from God Almighty, and you can't get any higher than that. “Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.” He knows you only have a short amount of time here.

Right after that comes “your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”, because Satan is looking for the prideful, the ones who think they know more than God in the little time they have been here. We stress over three to five business days and get mad when Amazon doesn't deliver in two. God's small moment calls for humility, not pride.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 3:5
precepts.why:
We feel what we are going through. We complain, we cry, we fast, we do what we can to make it through. But look what God calls it: “And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded”. A little chastised. We are not even yet at the point of being persecuted and put to death, and he calls this a little chastising.

That fits with 2 Peter 3:8: if one day with the Lord is as a thousand years, a whole lifetime of suffering is a little chastising, less than two hours in his eyes, and the reward that follows is eternal.

Then, “for God proved them, and found them worthy for himself.” The chastising is the proving. He tries us to find us worthy unto himself. So we have to endure to the end, people. We have to endure to the end, humbling ourselves under his mighty hand, and when the short moment is over, those found worthy will be greatly rewarded.

thread.label: 1 John 2:18-19
thread.text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

precepts.label: Acts 15:5
precepts.why:
John is the only one in the Bible who calls a system or a person the antichrist. The prophets spoke of that last kingdom that would fight against Christ at his return, but they did not call it antichrist. John says “as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”, which is future, “even now are there many antichrists”. Anti means against. Even in John's time many were against Christ.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us”. These were men among the apostles who up and left the apostles and their teachings, which were the teachings of Christ, and went out teaching against them. They said the resurrection had taken place already. They taught that you have to be circumcised. That is an antichrist doctrine, one form of antichrist in the time of the apostles.

That goes back to the history in Acts 15: “But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.” The Pharisees were pushing first and foremost that they had to be circumcised after the manner of Moses, meaning the old covenant of animal sacrifice, and not Christ. It is not only circumcision of the foreskin, because that is a law we have to do; it is that they pushed that before they pushed Christ.

So from the beginning there were many antichrists: those who went out from the apostles and taught contrary to Christ. That is why John says “they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.”

precepts.label: Colossians 1:18
precepts.why:
Diotrephes is another kind of hireling: he “loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.” And the strange thing is, the apostles set this man up. He was always around and made it appear like he was in the truth. But everybody's problem isn't always sex; some brothers want power, preeminence. I was never anything in the world; I'm going to come in and be somebody. Not by the word of God, but by being deceitful and slick and witty, disrespectful in a secretive way.

Paul settles who has the preeminence: “And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.” There is only one preeminent, and that is Christ. He is the king; not you, not me. Christ has the preeminence, not Diotrephes. Diotrephes lost his mind, and you know why? He was a hireling.

We have seen it: a brother in the office of ten sees a congregation in Alaska with no senior man, asks no counsel, pops up, and shazam, he's over the congregation, and because he came from the States they love him and accept him. It happened in Ghana and many of the African countries. Another went out, and where were the congregation's donations? In his personal bank account. You can't make this up. These are hirelings; they don't believe, and there is no fear among them.

Diotrephes was “prating against us with malicious words”: always something smart to say, I know what he knows, I know more precepts than you. He would not receive the brethren, not even the ones that taught him, and cast out any who wanted to visit the apostles. But John says “if I come, I will remember his deeds”, and “Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.”

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 4:12
precepts.why:
John is told, “What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, and the first of them is Ephesus. Paul writes to Timothy, “And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.”

That same Tychicus was sent to Colosse. In Colossians 4, “All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts”, together “With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.”

Ephesus is right there next to Colosse. The same messengers served that whole region, going between the churches of Asia. So the Colossians were not off by themselves: they were part of that same body of churches in Asia that Christ sent his word to in Revelation.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:16
precepts.why:
Paul tells the Colossians, “And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.” The letters went back and forth between Colosse and Laodicea.

Laodicea is the last of the seven churches in Revelation 1:11: “Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.” And Laodicea was right there next to Colosse.

Now it connects better. Colosse may not be named as one of the churches of Asia in the book of Acts, but when you put the map up, the churches of Asia are all right there together: Laodicea, Philadelphia, Sardis, all right there by Colosse. So when John was told to send what he saw “unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, it was the same region and the same people the epistle to the Colossians was written to.

precepts.label: Genesis 49:12
precepts.why:
John saw one like unto the Son of man, and “his eyes were as a flame of fire.” That line tripped up Carlos, the host of the podcast The Theology of the Streets: was it literal, or figurative? So we go line upon line, to Genesis 49:12: “His eyes shall be red with wine.” When you drink wine, the whites of your eyes turn red. That is the flame of fire John saw. Christ drank wine, and Christ did not have blue eyes.

The same verse finishes, “and his teeth white with milk.” His teeth were white, and the milk has a meaning of its own, which 1 Peter 2:2 opens.

It fits the rest of the description. “His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow”: that tells two things, the color and the texture. The color is white; the texture is wool, like the woolly hair of the negro, as some of the old dictionaries define woolly. Christ did not have blonde hair; he had an afro, white like wool. The pictures shown are not an exact image of Christ, but a more accurate depiction according to the scriptures.

This matters because our people say the image does not matter, as long as he is in my heart. But if you do not know what Christ looks like, you will be deceived and fall for the white man’s Jesus. Line upon line, here a little and there a little, is how the understanding comes, and it is not for everybody. If you are not keeping the commandments, or you go by what the Christian pastors teach, you will get lost.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 2:2
precepts.why:
Genesis 49:12 says of Judah’s promised ruler, “his teeth white with milk.” The question is what the milk represents, and Peter answers it: “As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby.” The milk is the word.

So Christ’s teeth were white with milk because he came teaching the laws. What came out of his mouth was the word, the laws of his Father. That is what the white like milk represents.

It is the same kind of speech as “his voice as the sound of many waters.” He had a deep voice, and the scripture says it the way our people talk, in idiom. When a king was rich the scripture says he waxed fat; when Saul relieved himself it says he covered his feet. That is hip talk, and it is how you know the scriptures were written by our people, Israelites who speak in parables, as Christ and the prophets did.

Read that way, the whole picture in Revelation lines up: a black man with woolly hair, like the woolly hair of the negro, white like wool, eyes red with wine, feet “like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace,” black like brass that has been burned, and a mouth full of the law.

thread.label: Revelation 2:26
thread.text: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

precepts.label: Isaiah 54:17
precepts.why:
“And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations.” Some do not understand what that power is going to give us, so Isaiah shows it. Read verse 16 first: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” That is talking about the nuclear weapon.

Then: “No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper.” Think about it: Esau shoots a nuclear weapon and you walk right through it. That is what you call power. When he says power, some of you have no idea what that means. That is power.

Can their weapons prosper against us today? Yes. That is why we must wait for that power. And it goes on: “and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” In that day, let me hear somebody rise against us with his tongue. I double dare you. Every tongue will be condemned.

“This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.” This is our heritage. We are the servants, and our righteousness is of the Most High.

So overcome whatever you are fighting: drug addiction, alcohol addiction, woman addiction, men addiction. Keep his works, his laws, unto the end, which is either you die in this or Christ comes back. Now is not the time to pick up knives and guns; a gun or a little knife cannot do anything but get you killed. We wait in faith for that spiritual power, and then we rule the nations with a rod of iron and break them to shivers like the vessels of a potter.

precepts.label: Psalms 91:5
precepts.why:
He that overcomes and keeps Christ's works unto the end gets “power over the nations”, to “rule them with a rod of iron.” No weapon formed against us will prosper, and Psalm 91 goes with that: “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.”

The arrow that flieth by day is the missile. Read on: “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side.” What weapon do you think can do that? A gun cannot do that. That is nuclear destruction, and it is not going to touch you.

A thousand at thy side, “and ten thousand at thy right hand.” Think about it: you stand there, ten thousand people drop dead, and nothing can affect you. That is the type of power the Lord will give to him that overcometh.

That is why we must overcome and wait. I want that power to rule the nations, to break them just like they break us. But it is not talking about right now. We must have faith and wait for that spiritual power, and in that day nothing the nations send against us will come nigh us.

thread.label: Revelation 3:7-10
thread.text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

precepts.label: Isaiah 57:1-2
precepts.why:
Philadelphia means brotherly love, and that church was a colony of Israelites. Christ, “he that hath the key of David”, tells them: “behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it”. That open door is salvation. “For thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.” They were under persecution, so he says he will make the synagogue of Satan come and worship before their feet.

Then verse 10: “Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world”. The hour of temptation is Jacob’s trouble, which leads into the world war and Armageddon. The church of Philadelphia will not be there when it happens. Does that mean a force field around them? No. They are at rest.

Isaiah 57 shows it: “The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.” That is exactly what we just read in Revelation 3:10. “He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.” Each one walking: they are not dead.

So when brothers and sisters die and people say, they keep dying, listen: I have a reason. They are at rest. You do your little tears and cry, that’s fine, but the Lord is keeping the righteous from the evil to come, the way he kept Philadelphia from the hour of temptation.

precepts.label: Daniel 12:2-3
precepts.why:
Isaiah 57 says the righteous “shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness”: they are not dead. Daniel 12 says the same thing.

“And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake”. Those that sleep in the dust are the ones that died, and they shall awake, “some to everlasting life”: the righteous brothers and the righteous sisters; “and some to shame and everlasting contempt.”

“And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.”

So the saints who died keeping the word of Christ’s patience are only sleeping. They were kept from the hour of temptation that comes upon all the world, Jacob’s trouble, and they will awake to everlasting life. That is why we do not grieve the righteous the way the world does.

thread.text: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

classes.title: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:5
precepts.why:
Four angels stand on the four corners of the earth, “holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea”. So what is the wind that is going to blow on the earth? It cannot be a normal wind. It is windy every single day. This is a different type of wind.

Ezra shows it: “And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea.” So the winds are the armies of the earth, gathered to subdue the man that came out of the sea, and sent to bring destruction on this earth.

Then the angel with the seal of the living God cries to the four angels, “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” The armies are held back; no destruction of mass proportions is coming until the hundred and forty and four thousand are sealed, and that seal is the law.

So if you truly want the end to come, you are going to be out here teaching your people and raising up the nation of Israel. The Most High God is waiting on a specific number, 144,000 unified in keeping the commandments and the faith of Christ, and then deliverance will come. The Christian church never even talks about the 144,000, because it is not about the deliverance of our people. Unity is the sweet savor of salvation.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:5
precepts.why:
Four angels hold the four winds of the earth, and another angel cries to them, “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” The four winds are held back for a reason, and Ezra shows what gathers from those four winds.

“And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea.” That multitude out of number is their military, gathered from the four winds to fight against Christ, the man that came out of the sea.

So the holding of the winds is this: do not let war pop off to the max until the servants of God are sealed. The armies of the nations are held back until the leaders of Israel, the hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes, are sealed with the law of God in Christ.

precepts.label: Isaiah 8:16
precepts.why:
The angel ascending from the east has “the seal of the living God”, and the servants of our God are sealed in their foreheads. What is that seal? Isaiah says it: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is the seal of the living God: the law, sealed among his disciples, in Christ.

And the ones sealed are “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”, twelve thousand of every tribe, from Juda to Benjamin. These are the leaders; the 144,000 is just the leading men. In order for them to be sealed, they have to know who they are, at least to some extent.

So how are you going to read that and be confused about the twelve tribes? You just read all of the tribes right there. You can't make this stuff up.

thread.text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in thei

precepts.label: Hosea 1:10
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number”. Now that we are bringing this out, the churches say we are all included, all backgrounds and cultures together. Where was that in 1964? Where was it on the slave ships? That is why the Bible says precept must be upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little.

Hosea 1:10: “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered”. That is us. The multitude “which no man could number” is the children of Israel, whose number cannot be measured nor numbered.

“And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” The people told they were not God’s people are the same ones called the sons of the living God.

It also shows time has gone by. Moses said “ye shall be left few in number among the heathen”, because they were killing us; Hosea says we would grow to be like the sand of the sea. That is the great multitude standing before the throne.

precepts.label: Acts 2:5
precepts.why:
The great multitude is “of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”, and the Christian says, see, we are all included. But read Acts 2:5: “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.”

Out of every nation under heaven, and they were Jews. So “all nations” in Revelation 7:9 does not mean every race; it means the Israelites scattered into every nation, gathered out of them.

That is the all nations of Revelation 7:9: Jews out of every nation under heaven, the same people as the sand of the sea that cannot be numbered, standing before the throne and before the Lamb.

precepts.label: Isaiah 11:10-12
precepts.why:
If you have time on the street, add Isaiah 11: “the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people”. Why the second time? Because the first time was under Moses.

He recovers the remnant “from Assyria”, modern-day Turkey, where you have the Afro-Turks; “and from Egypt”, lower Egypt and the Afro-Egyptians; “and from Pathros”, modern-day southern Sudan; “and from Cush”, Ethiopia; “and from Elam”, Iran and India, with the Afro-Iranians, the Siddis and the Dalits; “and from Shinar”, Iraq today and the Afro-Iraqis; “and from Hamath”, Syria today and the Afro-Syrians; “and from the islands of the sea”, like Cape Verde, the Hawaiian islands and the Melanesian islands.

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.” We are the outcasts of Israel.

That is the all nations right there: the remnant of Israel gathered out of every land they were scattered to, the great multitude of Revelation 7:9.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 2:38-42
precepts.why:
Revelation 7:4 gives “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”, and then verse 9 gives the great multitude. They say, see, we are all included. Ezra explains it crystal clear.

“Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”. That is Revelation 7:4, the 144,000. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of the Lord”: new bodies. “Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord. The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”. Verses 38 to 41 are Revelation 7:4.

Now verse 42: “I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.” That is Revelation 7:9. The great multitude is Zion, mount Zion.

So the 144,000 are the men, the Israelite leaders of the twelve tribes; the great multitude are more men, women and children of Israel. And “these are they which came out of great tribulation”: so much for the church teaching that we don’t have to go through tribulation.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
Revelation 12:14 says the woman is “nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.” We are nourished from America. Everything we have, every place we live, the foods we eat, the drinks we drink, the clothes we wear, the educations we have received, has come from this white man, the dragon. John calls him the serpent.

Deuteronomy 28:48 says the same thing, but Moses does not use the word serpent. Look at the word he uses: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”. Moses used the word enemies. “in hunger”: you have to serve him for food. “and in thirst”: for water. “and in nakedness”: for clothing. “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, if you want education, if you want medicine, you have to go to your enemies.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” That is the history Moses prophesied, and the same history John the revelator prophesied. Moses called him the enemy, and John called him the serpent. The woman fed in the wilderness for a time, and times, and half a time, three and a half, is Israel living off the hand of the enemy that holds the yoke on her neck.

thread.label: Revelation 12:7-9
thread.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

precepts.label: Isaiah 27:1
precepts.why:
Daniel said, “And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered.” That time is Armageddon, when all nations rise up and fight, and Michael rises up to fight for us. Revelation 12 is the same thing: “And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.” It's not talking about war in the sky, as Christians say, Lucifer fighting with God and his angels. It's all nations fighting with each other. This is the time of trouble.

“and the dragon fought and his angels.” Who is the dragon? Lucifer: America and Europe. His angels are his armies. Isaiah proves it: “In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.”

Leviathan, the piercing serpent, that crooked serpent, is the white man. And the dragon that is in the sea is America. The Lord will punish him with his great and strong sword in that day, the same day Michael stands up for Daniel's people and they are delivered.

precepts.label: Psalms 74:13-14
precepts.why:
“Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.” Remember what we read: “the dragon fought and his angels.” That's what we are reading about here: Christ and Michael and the angels fighting against the white man and his army.

“Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.” The heads of leviathan are all the heads: Europe, France, all of them; America, all of them. Christ is going to destroy that dragon, the whole government.

That is why Revelation says the dragon and his angels “prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” They don't win against Michael and the angels. When Christ returns, Michael and the angels fight against the white man and his army, and every head of leviathan is broken in pieces.

precepts.label: Isaiah 24:21-22
precepts.why:
This explains the war in heaven: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit.” The high ones that are on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America, and the kings of the earth too. The gathering into the pit goes into Revelation 20.

Isaiah 34 shows what heaven means. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”: in Revelation their armies are called his angels. “he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.” “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll.” “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Is this heaven paradise? No. This heaven is the governments of this world, and the sword comes down upon Idumea, Edom, the people of his curse.

So the dragon in Revelation 12 is Edom, the fourth beast, also called the Devil and Satan. That war in heaven is Christ fighting with the white man and his armies: Lucifer falling from heaven: how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer. “neither was their place found any more in heaven”: they have no rulership any more on this earth. And the one “which deceiveth the whole world” is not just a spiritual demon; it's his children, the white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.

precepts.label: Job 10:14
precepts.why:
“And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”. What is that mark? Is it a computer chip? They are experimenting; there are reports of cutting open prisoners' heads to put in a chip to modify their behavior. But if your behavior is modified, how could God judge you for it? It would not be you thinking; it would have you like a robot. The mark is something willfully taken.

Job tells you what it is: “If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” Sin is the mark.

But sin has been here since the time of Adam and Eve, so how is sin the mark? Sin becomes the mark when it becomes law to sin. The mark in your right hand and your forehead is sin in your mind and your thoughts, and your support of sin.

And “that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark”. That is where digital money comes in: a central bank digital currency, where they can turn the switch and you have no money if you do anything they don't like. They already did it to Francesca Albanese for speaking against Israel, sanctioning her and cutting her off from her bank account, and to the members of the International Criminal Court. We are in that time. We push Revelation 2:9 and 3:9; you don't think one of them will say, shut his bank account down, that'll shut them up?

precepts.label: 1 Maccabees 1:41
precepts.why:
Sin is the mark when it becomes law to sin, and Maccabees shows it happening historically: “Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.”

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” That is Christianity: consenting to the king's religion, and profaning the sabbath.

What Revelation 13 says about no man buying or selling happened before. Precept must be upon precept: when you read it in Revelation, you have to find the historic scriptures that speak to it, 1 Maccabees 1:41 and on, and Daniel 3, and it leads to death. In Acts they commanded the apostles not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus. Don't fool yourself that it could never happen in America.

Some of you know the law, but when they shut down your bank account, it could break you. You can't pay the rent or the mortgage or the car note; you lose your car, your home, maybe your wife; a newborn baby and you can't get formula. Some will say, I'm going to go back and be a Christian so I can get access to my money. That is consenting to the king's religion, and taking the mark.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:30
precepts.why:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up”. The Euphrates runs from Iraq up through Syria to Turkey, and it is drying up right now, from severe droughts, with dams along it; whoever controls the water controls the agriculture. So don't tell us the Bible isn't true. We are in these days, the time is now. You won't read this in the Quran, the Gilgamesh epic or the Egyptian Book of the Dead; you only read it in the Bible.

Why is it dried up? So “that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Ezra shows who the kings of the east are: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Iranians. And the land of the Assyrians here is Israel: they are going to waste a portion of the land of Israel.

Then come the three unclean spirits out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet: politics with NATO, the financial system of the United States, and Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.” Those three spirits, all coming from the white man, are leading to war on top of war like we have never seen, and the way is being prepared for the kings of the east.

precepts.label: Numbers 24:17
precepts.why:
Christ says, “I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. Then why is Lucifer called “son of the morning”? The King James is the only version with Lucifer there, because the scholars who translated it understood something everybody else did not: there is a difference between that morning star and the morning star we read about all through the scriptures.

Balaam saw the true star: “I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob”. A star out of who? Out of Jacob. Did it say out of Esau? No: out of Jacob.

“and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”: a ruler shall rise out of Israel. “and shall smite the corners of Moab”, the Moabites, the Chinese, “and destroy all the children of Sheth.”

So the star in the scriptures is Christ, the ruler rising out of Israel, the offspring of David. The star comes out of Jacob, not Esau, and that is how we know the one called Lucifer, the false morning star, is a different one.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 1:19
precepts.why:
“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star: Christ, the day star that arises in your hearts.

Then why is the king of Babylon, America, referred to as Lucifer? Because “such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” “And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation, and for the last seventy years has pushed that it is here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth, after murdering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving millions of people.

That is why Isaiah calls him “Lucifer, son of the morning”: he says he is Christian, righteous, the light, and makes himself look like the morning star. But Christ is the real morning star, “the true Light”, and the day star Peter speaks of arises in the hearts of those who take heed to the sure word of prophecy.

He told them, when you see Jerusalem compassed with armies, run, and they fled. When it happened they said, that is what Christ was talking about.
